description:
**Important:** Applicants must have prior experience working at any interior design firm in the Delhi NCR. Please apply accordingly.

**About Serein Spaces**

Serein Spaces is a design‑led commercial interior design \& build firm focused on creating functional, branded workplaces. We partner with growth\-stage companies and enterprises to deliver end\-to\-end interior solutions — from concept and procurement to project delivery. Our culture values craft, clarity, collaboration, and operational rigour.

**Role Summary**

We’re hiring an experienced HR Manager to own end‑to‑end HR operations for Serein Spaces. This role requires proven HR experience specifically within commercial interior design, architecture, construction, or fit\-out companies. You will run HR processes for a growing, project\-driven organisation: recruitment, onboarding, payroll, compliance, performance management, employee relations, policies, learning \& development, and HR analytics.

Key Responsibilities

* End‑to‑end recruitment: develop role briefs, source candidates (including campus \& industry channels), screen, run interviews with hiring managers, coordinate offers and onboarding. Strong track record hiring designers, project managers, site engineers, procurement, and operations staff in interior/fit‑out firms.
* Onboarding \& offboarding: design and execute smooth onboarding, probation reviews, exit interviews, and knowledge capture for project continuity.
* HR operations \& payroll: administer payroll, benefits, statutory compliance (ESI, PF, professional tax, TDS), leave management, and vendor coordination (payroll, statutory filings).
* Employee relations: handle grievances, disciplinary processes, conflict resolution, and maintain a positive workplace climate across office \& site teams.
* Performance \& career management: implement performance review cycles, goal setting, KPI alignment with project delivery, and career/pathway frameworks for design and operations roles.
* Compensation \& benefits: support compensation benchmarking, salary reviews, incentive structures (project completion incentives, bonuses), and ESOP coordination where applicable.
* L\&D \& talent development: identify skill gaps for designers, PMs, and site teams; run internal training, certifications, and mentorship programs tied to business needs.
* HR policies \& documentation: create and update employee handbook, role\-based SOPs, JD templates, employment agreements, and site safety HR protocols.
* HR systems \& analytics: manage HRMS/ATS, maintain accurate HR records, produce monthly HR dashboards (headcount, attrition, hiring funnel, bench utilisation, payroll metrics).
* Culture \& engagement: run engagement initiatives, townhalls, recognition programs, and initiatives that bridge design studio and site teams.
* Project\-oriented HR support: align staffing plans to project pipelines, manage contractor and vendor workforce onboarding, and support workforce mobilization/ demobilization for sites.

Must\-have Qualifications \& Experience

* 5\+ years HR experience with at least 2–3 years in a commercial interior/fit‑out/architecture/construction firm in an HR generalist or HR Manager role.
* Strong operational experience: recruitment across design \& site roles, payroll \& statutory compliance, HR policies.
* Hands\-on knowledge of hiring technical roles: interior designers, architects, project managers, site engineers, procurement, and MEP coordinators.
* Practical understanding of project\-driven staffing models, site safety considerations, and contract labour management.
* Excellent interpersonal \& stakeholder management skills; able to influence founders, project heads, and site managers.
* Familiarity with HRMS/ATS tools, Google Workspace/Office 365, and basic HR analytics/spreadsheets.

**Talent Acquisition Executive**

 **Job Description (Talent Acquisition Executive)**

Support end\-to\-end recruitment delivery by sourcing, screening, and coordinating hiring activities across multiple roles and functions. Partner with recruiters and HR stakeholders to build strong talent pipelines, ensure smooth execution of hiring processes, and deliver a positive candidate experience. Leverage multiple sourcing channels, maintain accurate recruitment data, and contribute to employer branding efforts to attract high\-quality talent aligned with business needs.

**Key Responsibilities**
**1\. Talent Sourcing \& Pipeline Support**
* Source and identify potential candidates through job portals, social media, referrals, and talent databases for open and pipeline roles.
* Support the development of talent pools for recurring and critical roles to improve hiring turnaround time.
* Assist in basic talent mapping exercises to identify relevant candidate segments in the market.
* Maintain and update candidate pipelines in the ATS/trackers for effective follow\-ups and conversions.


**2\. Screening \& Engagement**
* Conduct initial screening of candidates to assess role fit based on defined criteria (skills, experience, location, compensation).
* Coordinate and schedule interviews, ensuring a smooth candidate journey across stages.
* Maintain regular communication with candidates to ensure high engagement and experience quality.
* Provide timely feedback and closure to candidates, including managing offer declines and drop\-offs.


**3\. Stakeholder Coordination**
* Partner with recruiters and hiring managers to understand role requirements and support fulfilment.
* Provide regular updates on sourcing progress, pipeline status, and challenges.
* Support hiring teams with interview scheduling, documentation, and coordination.


**4\. Job Posting \& Employer Branding Support**
* Assist in drafting and posting job advertisements across internal and external platforms.
* Support employer branding initiatives such as career fairs, campus hiring, and social media campaigns.
* Ensure job postings are clear, accurate, and aligned to market expectations.


**5\. Recruitment Operations \& Reporting**
* Maintain accurate candidate records, trackers, and recruitment reports.
* Ensure compliance with recruitment policies, documentation standards, and audit requirements.
* Track basic recruitment metrics such as number of profiles sourced, interview conversions, and offer join rates.


**6\. Continuous Learning \& Process Support**
* Stay updated on sourcing techniques, job market trends, and hiring tools.
* Support process improvements to enhance efficiency, turnaround time, and candidate experience.
* Work closely with recruiters to improve quality of profiles and sourcing effectiveness over time.


**Key Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong sourcing and coordination skills
* Basic understanding of recruitment lifecycle
* Good communication and stakeholder management
* Attention to detail and process orientation
* Ability to manage multiple roles and timelines
* Familiarity with job portals, LinkedIn, and ATS tools

**Job Summary:**

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced **School Manager / Academic Director** to oversee the academic and operational functions of our school. This leadership role is responsible for driving academic excellence, managing faculty performance, implementing curriculum standards, and ensuring efficient day\-to\-day school operations. The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker with strong organizational, communication, and leadership skills, committed to fostering a positive and productive school environment.

* Promote a culture of high expectations and continuous learning for both students and teachers.

**Staff \& Teacher Management:**

* Recruit, train, supervise, and evaluate teaching and non\-teaching staff.
* Conduct regular staff meetings, performance reviews, and professional development workshops.
* Provide guidance, mentoring, and support to teachers to enhance instructional effectiveness.

* Oversee the daily operations of the school including schedules, calendars, and events.
* Ensure compliance with health, safety, and regulatory standards.
* Coordinate with administrative departments (HR, admissions, etc.) to support smooth school operations.

**Parent \& Community Engagement:**

* Maintain effective communication with parents and guardians regarding academic progress, school policies, and events.
* Foster a positive school culture and maintain strong relationships within the school community.

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Education or related field (Master’s preferred).
* Proven experience (minimum 10 years) in a school leadership or academic coordination role, principal.
* Strong understanding of curriculum design, academic planning, and educational best practices.

Monitor delinquencies, yield, tonnage, auction ratios, spurious/bentex cases, and branch growth metric**3\) Job Context \& Major Challenges:** Write the specific aspects of the job that provide a challenge (internal and external) to the jobholder in the context of the Business/Unit/Function/Department/Section **(****Max 3975 Characters)**
==============================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

 **Organization Context**
Aditya Birla Capital Limited ("NBFC") is registered with RBI as a Systematically Important Non\-Deposit accepting Non\-Banking Finance Company (NBFC). ABCL is one of the top private diversified NBFCs in India. As of 31\-Sep’25, ABCL has a pan\-India presence with a lending book of approx. Rs. 139,500 Crores.  

ABCL offers end\-to\-end lending solutions to a diverse set of customers \- Retail, HNI, MSMEs, and Mid \& Large Corporates through secured as well as unsecured loan products. The diverse range of lending products includes Retail Small Ticket Secured and Unsecured Loans, Unsecured Personal Loans, Unsecured Business Loans, Health \& Education Loans, Digital B2B2C and B2B2B Small Ticket Loans, Small Business Secured Loans, Loans Against Property (LAP), Lease Rental Discounting (LRD), Construction Finance (to Real Estate Developers), SME Loans, Capital Markets Loans (Loan Against Shares), Supply Chain Finance, Mid and Large Corporate Loans, and Infrastructure Finance loans. ABCL also has a Wealth Management division.  

ABCL is rated “AAA” by India Ratings, ICRA and CARE (reaffirmed in 2020\). ABCL secured the ABG Business Excellence Award in 2017 (Silver), and 2015 (Bronze), and multiple other Awards on forums like CII. **Business Context**
Gold Loans is a key secured lending product with high volume, fast turnaround expectations and requires strict discipline in risk, valuation, purity testing, and customer trust management. **Job Context:**  

The Branch Manager executes gold loan business at the branch level, ensuring revenue, portfolio quality, and operational governance. The role balances growth, yield optimization, and compliance while managing a small but high?impact team and ensuring branch\-level risk controls **Key Challenges:*** Achieving aggressive customer acquisition, disbursement and tonnage growth in competitive local markets.
* Maintaining strict LTV adherence, gold purity compliance, and accurate valuation amid gold price fluctuations.
* Ensuring timely closure of spurious/bentex cases and minimizing auction\-to\-book ratio.
* Driving collection resolutions for 0–30 DPD while preventing slippages.
* Ensuring branch audit scores \>90% with zero tolerance deviations.
* Delivering consistent customer experience in high\-sensitivity product category (emotional asset).
* Motivating and developing frontline staff for continuous sales and service productivity

 **Key Result Areas (Max 1325 Characters)** **Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)** **Business Growth \& Acquisition*** Achieve targets for new CUID creation.
* Drive new customer disbursements as per percentile role benchmarks.
* Ensure net growth and tonnage growth in line with branch plan.
 **Yield \& Profitability Management*** Achieve onboarding yield benchmarks
* Drive optimal ticket size, renewal mix, and repeat customer engagement.
* Ensure cost\-efficient branch operations.
 **Portfolio Quality \& Risk Management*** Maintain auction\-to\-book ratio
* Ensure strict adherence to LTV, documentation quality, and purity testing protocols.
* Resolve spurious and bentex cases within defined timelines
 **Collections \& Delinquency Management*** Deliver resolution for 0–30 DPD bucket.
* Monitor overdue accounts and perform timely follow\-up.
* Support recovery actions as per internal guidelines.
 **Compliance, Audit \& Governance*** Achieve audit score as defined, ensure closure of audit findings.
* Maintain zero\-tolerance on operational deviations and regulatory breaches.
* Ensure accuracy in process, record keeping, and vault management.
 **Customer Service \& Branch Experience*** Ensure high service quality, fast turnaround time, and seamless grievance resolution.
* Maintain branch hygiene, safety, and security standards.
 **People Leadership \& Productivity*** Lead ABM, Gold Valuer, GLO, and CSE for daily performance.
* Conduct coaching, on\-the\-job training, and reviews.
* Ensure manpower productivity as per branch benchmarks

title: Data Quality Executive – Field Operations
description:
**Job Description**  

The purpose of this role is to ensure the integrity, reliability, and quality of data during live fieldwork by conducting continuous quality checks, proactive validations, and early issue detection. The role focuses on minimizing errors at the source through daily monitoring, Personal Back Checks (PBCs), and spot audits, thereby preventing data discrepancies and reducing downstream rework.


By identifying and addressing potential risks in real time, this position plays a critical role in maintaining adherence to research protocols, improving field execution standards, and safeguarding the overall credibility of study outcomes. Ultimately, the role contributes to delivering accurate, high\-quality insights and enhancing client trust.

**Responsibilities**

* Responsible for ensuring high standards of data quality during ongoing fieldwork by conducting continuous monitoring, proactive checks, and early issue identification to prevent data errors and maintain study integrity.
* Conduct daily quality checks across all active fieldwork projects to ensure adherence to study protocols and research methodologies.
* Monitor interviewer performance and response patterns.
* Identify inconsistencies, irregularities, or deviations from defined quality standards.
* Perform proactive Personal Back Checks (PBCs) during live fieldwork to validate 1\. Respondent authenticity 2\.Interview accuracy 3\.Data reliability and 4\. Target group authentication.
* Ensure that interviews are conducted as per guidelines and ethical standards
* Document findings and escalate discrepancies in a timely manner.
* Identify potential risks or recurring quality issues early in the fieldwork cycle.
* Take corrective actions such as 1\- Flagging suspicious interviews 2\- recommending rework OR respondent replacement.
* Work closely with project managers, and operations teams to implement preventive actions.
* Provide feedback and guidance to improve field execution quality.
* Support training initiatives based on recurring quality issues.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Market Research, Business, or related field.
* 2–5 years of experience in fieldwork quality control, data validation, or survey operations.
* Strong understanding of market research methodologies and field processes.
* Experience in conducting PBCs, spot checks, and quality audits.
* Ability to coach, influence, and hold interviewers accountable.
* Proficiency in Excel.
* Strong attention to detail and problem\-solving skills.
* Good communication skills for coordination with field teams and stakeholders.
* Computer literacy and accurate keyboard skills.
* Proficiency in local language(s) both written and verbal.
* Thorough understanding of the related NielsenIQ SOPs and field work standards.

11\. Coordinate FLS coding and FLS tagging with HO  

  

12\. Coordinate for advisor / FLS Reward and Recognitions and for domestic \& overseas sales conference with HO  


KRA2 Execute  

  

Advisor Licensing process \& extend Sales Support 13\. Contact updation in BSLI online of Advisors and FLS  

  

14\. Contactability enhancement at NB stage,post welcome call followed by CRT.  

  

15\. Preparation of Various MIS related to BSLI Way and updation of Various Dash Boards.  

  

16\. Coordination with various institutes, approved by Training Head, for the training of new Insurance Applicant.  

  

17\. Re exam scheduling of failed candidates in coordination with BH/AMs  

  

18\. Coordination with RHR for offer letter generation for FLS  

  

19\. Arrangement of Various training programmes in Branches coordinating with Training manager and BM/BH.  

  

20\. Downloading various process to Sales team during morning huddle (BSLI Way).  

  

21\. Ensure timely opening and closing of office premises

2\. Procurement of vendor bills, establishing genuineness and timely payment as per agreement.  

  

3\. Encourage NEFT registrations of vendors.  

  

4\. Support lease agreement registration and renewal process.  

  

5\. New branch set up\- coordination with various functions like IT/Infra/banking/ZOPS/DSF for smooth functions of branch.  


KRA4 Extend Legal , Compliance and Taxation support 1\. Timely remittance of professional and work contract tax.
  

  

2\. Represent company on behalf of compliance/HO for hearing matters in labour/consumer court.  

  

3\. Timely updates to HO on receipt of any notice from Tax authorities/labour offices/employment exchange/Local municipal offices.  

  

4\. Ensure statutory displays at branches.  

  

5\. Ensure 100% compliance of AML guidelines, identification and reporting of suspicious \& fraudulent operational and financial transactions.  

  

6\. Adherence to BCP guidelines.  


KRA5 A\- Handle Advisor commission process  

  

  

  

  

  

  

  

  

  

  

  

  

  

  

  

  

  

  

  

  

B\- Provide HR/IT/Admin support A\- 1\. Timely Updation \& handover of Commission chq to Advisors.  

  

2\. Encourage NEFT with advisors and FLS.  

  

3\. Resolve commission related queries of advisor.  

  

4\. Ensure timely receipts and hand\-over of TDS certificate to advisors.  

  

B\- 1\. Manage joining and exit formalities for concerned employees at the branch, including full and final settlement process.  

  

2\. Log calls in case of downtime/pursue with Corporate IT.
  

  

3\. Monitor and ensure housekeeping, security and dispatch services are rendered in an uninterrupted and cost effective manner.
  

  

4\. Handle physical resource booking like meeting rooms, projectors, etc.  


KRA6 Execute Underwriting and New Business processes 1\. Scrutinise New Business applications as per the SOPs to ensure 100% input accuracy to enhance straight through processing and issuance to submission ratio.  

  

2\. Arrange speedy pick up of medical reports from medical labs and timely transmission of applications, medical reports, requirements via scanning and indexing with 100% accuracy.
  

  

3\. Collaborate with head office process owners/vendors to facilitate faster issuance.  

  

4\. Ensure timely and accurate updation and delivery of policy documents/refund cheques in adherence to set standards.  


KRA7 Provide prompt, accurate and courteous Customer Service 1\. Ensure 1st contact resolution at the branch for all internal \& external customers’ \& track requests through prescribed systems ensuring 100% accuracy and timely closure.  

  

2\. Scrutinise claims documentation as per set guidelines and coordination with sales force and claimant for speedy fulfilment of claim requirements.
  

  

3\. Ensure 100% accurate and timely scrutiny \& processing of reinstatement, fund switch, financial payout requests \& other customer requests on the same day to avoid Gain/Loss. Customer identity \& signature to be verified to establish genuineness of the transaction.  

  

4\. Proactively participate in data cleansing exercise for both internal \& external customers in respect of Bank details, PAN card Information, contact details \& undelivered communications, .  


KRA8 Contribute to Revenue Generation \& conservation at every single opportunity \& instance. 1\. Encourage NEFT enrolment for internal \& external customers  

  

2\. Participating in Persistency drive by sharing data with sales force \& contacting customers for the allocated data base.  

  

3\. Encourage use of self help tools like Go Green, ECS activation, alternate payment options by customers.  

  

4\. Enhance contactability of the customers by collecting contact details.  

  

5\. Participate in cost savings initiatives.
  

  

6\. Actively endeavour towards containing Freelook/ Surrender / withdrawal at branches by convincing customers.  

  

7\. Actively engage with visiting customers to enhance revenue generation for the business by way of promoting Riders \& top up adding to incremental premium on the existing policies for the Co.  


KRA9 Contribute to Revenue Generation \& conservation at every single opportunity \& instance. 8\. Intimate \& pursue cheque dishonour cases with the respective sales team members / customer both at new business \& renewal stage \& strive for repayment to conserve the revenue.  

  

9\. Identify \& report fraudulent claims by providing proof / information to Claims team and get involved with the investigation as much required and sought.  

  

10\. Prevent Fraudulent / Fake Policies from issuance by Branches by controlling the document verification and reporting to Compliance \& UW  

  

11\. Save cost (on controllable expenses) at Branches on Electricity, Stationery, Photocopying, Staff Welfare, Other Miscellaneous Expenses etc

--------------------

######

===========================================================================================================================================

 **Business**  

Financial Services **Unit**  

Aditya Birla Capital Limited **Location**  

Across branches in India  

  

**1\) Job Purpose:** *Write the purpose for which the job exists (in 2\-3 lines)* **(****Max 1325 Characters)**
===============================================================================================================

  

The Branch Manager – Gold Loans is responsible for driving branch\-level business performance, ensuring compliance, delivering superior customer experience, and maintaining portfolio quality. The role leads the frontline team to achieve disbursement, new customer acquisition, yield, audit, collections, and risk KPIs while upholding operational governance. **2\) Dimensions:** *Mention quantitative or qualitative parameters that are relevant for the job and provide a better understanding of the scope and scale of the job.* **New Relationship**  

 (Max 254 Characters)

  

Build strong relationships with local customers, partners, authorities, and community influencers to drive branch customer acquisition. **Managing Existing Relationship**  

 (Max 254 Characters)

  

Lead and supervise branch staff including ABM, Gold Valuer, GLO, and CSE; ensure productivity and performance management **Structuring new Transactions**  

 (Max 254 Characters)

  

Ensure accurate gold valuation, loan structuring within LTV norms, and proper documentation for all new and renewal transactions **Compliance of regulatory guidelines**  

 (Max 254 Characters)

  

Ensure strict adherence to RBI norms, internal policies, risk processes, purity testing, and audit standards. **Portfolio monitoring**

  

Monitor delinquencies, yield, tonnage, auction ratios, spurious/bentex cases, and branch growth metric**3\) Job Context \& Major Challenges:** Write the specific aspects of the job that provide a challenge (internal and external) to the jobholder in the context of the Business/Unit/Function/Department/Section **(****Max 3975 Characters)**
==============================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

 **Organization Context**
Aditya Birla Capital Limited ("NBFC") is registered with RBI as a Systematically Important Non\-Deposit accepting Non\-Banking Finance Company (NBFC). ABCL is one of the top private diversified NBFCs in India. As of 31\-Sep’25, ABCL has a pan\-India presence with a lending book of approx. Rs. 139,500 Crores.  

ABCL offers end\-to\-end lending solutions to a diverse set of customers \- Retail, HNI, MSMEs, and Mid \& Large Corporates through secured as well as unsecured loan products. The diverse range of lending products includes Retail Small Ticket Secured and Unsecured Loans, Unsecured Personal Loans, Unsecured Business Loans, Health \& Education Loans, Digital B2B2C and B2B2B Small Ticket Loans, Small Business Secured Loans, Loans Against Property (LAP), Lease Rental Discounting (LRD), Construction Finance (to Real Estate Developers), SME Loans, Capital Markets Loans (Loan Against Shares), Supply Chain Finance, Mid and Large Corporate Loans, and Infrastructure Finance loans. ABCL also has a Wealth Management division.  

ABCL is rated “AAA” by India Ratings, ICRA and CARE (reaffirmed in 2020\). ABCL secured the ABG Business Excellence Award in 2017 (Silver), and 2015 (Bronze), and multiple other Awards on forums like CII. **Business Context**
Gold Loans is a key secured lending product with high volume, fast turnaround expectations and requires strict discipline in risk, valuation, purity testing, and customer trust management. **Job Context:**  

The Branch Manager executes gold loan business at the branch level, ensuring revenue, portfolio quality, and operational governance. The role balances growth, yield optimization, and compliance while managing a small but high?impact team and ensuring branch\-level risk controls **Key Challenges:*** Achieving aggressive customer acquisition, disbursement and tonnage growth in competitive local markets.
* Maintaining strict LTV adherence, gold purity compliance, and accurate valuation amid gold price fluctuations.
* Ensuring timely closure of spurious/bentex cases and minimizing auction\-to\-book ratio.
* Driving collection resolutions for 0–30 DPD while preventing slippages.
* Ensuring branch audit scores \>90% with zero tolerance deviations.
* Delivering consistent customer experience in high\-sensitivity product category (emotional asset).
* Motivating and developing frontline staff for continuous sales and service productivity
**4\) Key Result Areas:** Writethe key results expected from the job and the supporting actions for each of these key result areas (For most jobs typically there could be 4\- 7 key result areas)\- **Maximum 10 KRAs can be updated**
=======================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

 **Key Result Areas (Max 1325 Characters)** **Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)** **Business Growth \& Acquisition*** Achieve targets for new CUID creation.
* Drive new customer disbursements as per percentile role benchmarks.
* Ensure net growth and tonnage growth in line with branch plan.
 **Yield \& Profitability Management*** Achieve onboarding yield benchmarks
* Drive optimal ticket size, renewal mix, and repeat customer engagement.
* Ensure cost\-efficient branch operations.
 **Portfolio Quality \& Risk Management*** Maintain auction\-to\-book ratio
* Ensure strict adherence to LTV, documentation quality, and purity testing protocols.
* Resolve spurious and bentex cases within defined timelines
 **Collections \& Delinquency Management*** Deliver resolution for 0–30 DPD bucket.
* Monitor overdue accounts and perform timely follow\-up.
* Support recovery actions as per internal guidelines.
 **Compliance, Audit \& Governance*** Achieve audit score as defined, ensure closure of audit findings.
* Maintain zero\-tolerance on operational deviations and regulatory breaches.
* Ensure accuracy in process, record keeping, and vault management.
 **Customer Service \& Branch Experience*** Ensure high service quality, fast turnaround time, and seamless grievance resolution.
* Maintain branch hygiene, safety, and security standards.
 **People Leadership \& Productivity*** Lead ABM, Gold Valuer, GLO, and CSE for daily performance.
* Conduct coaching, on\-the\-job training, and reviews.
* Ensure manpower productivity as per branch benchmarks
**5\) Job Purpose of Direct Reports:** Describe the job purpose of the direct report/s to the job (in 2\-3 lines for each report)
=================================================================================================================================

  

* Assistant Branch Manager: Support branch business operations, supervise frontline staff, and drive daily productivity.
* Manager – Gold Valuation: Ensure accurate valuation, purity checks, risk adherence, and secure handling of gold assets.
* Gold Loan Officer: Acquire customers, drive disbursement, manage renewals, and maintain documentation accuracy.
* Customer Service Executive: Deliver superior customer experience, manage service transactions, and support branch operations.
**6\) Relationships:** Describe the nature and purpose of most important contacts or relationship (except superior/team members) with individuals, departments, organizations inside and outside of the organization, that job is required to interact with to deliver the job objectives

description:
Lead, HR Quality and Compliance

**Location:** Hyderabad


This is an office‑first role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and team alignment, enabling us to deliver our best work. You will work primarily in the office, with the flexibility to work remotely for 40% of your time (two days per week)

**Intro summary of the role**


This role is responsible for ensuring full statutory and regulatory compliance across HR, Payroll, and Talent Acquisition functions. The individual will proactively monitor legislative changes, implement necessary process updates, and partner with Legal, Finance, and HR Operations teams to manage compliance risk. The role also drives continuous improvement of payroll and TA processes while supporting audits, system enhancements, and key performance reporting. Strong stakeholder management and ownership of complex compliance issues are central to this position

**What you will get**

* An agile career and dynamic working culture.
* An inclusive and ethical workplace.
* Compensation programs that recognize high performance.
* A variety of benefits dependent on role and location.


The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits.

**What you will do**

* To ensure compliance with all statutory requirements, financial regulations or any other instructions in regard to HR, Payroll and Talent Acquisition (where applicable).
* Identify and implement changes to ensure that the Talent Acquisition and Payroll service is compliant, to current legislation, financial regulations, company policy and Labour Law and Agreements (CBA) as applicable to role
* Proactively monitor compliance changes in respective countries and provide compliance updates to HR Operations \& delivery teams, stakeholders and create/deliver communication plan to update impacted parties liaising with Lonza Legal team where required
* Whilst ensuring compliance and management of risk to always have the workforce experience at the heart of processes
* Ensure deadlines are met for statutory returns and payments where applicable.
* Continuous improvement of payroll related processes \& controls including business continuity plans, approaches to delivering a modern payroll function, simplification of legacy approaches.
* Continuous improvement of talent acquisition processes \& controls including business continuity plans, approaches to delivering a modern talent acquisition function, simplification of legacy approaches.
* Work closely with finance colleagues for monthly and period payroll\-related activities including reconciliations, maintenance of control accounts as applicable within HR, payroll and Talent Acquisition.
* Leading audits that impact HR Operations and Delivery with support from wider team
* Manage ad\-hoc projects.
* Take ownership of complex and technical issues and queries related to compliance and risk control.
* Advise the team and wider stakeholders on options and risks for a range of business decisions from a compliance and risk capacity perspective related to change.
* Cultivate relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
* To gather, analyse and provide the relevant details in support of performance indicators and targets as and when required i.e. TA/WFA/payroll performance quality and accuracy
* To provide appropriate management information as and when required.
* To assist in the development and implementation of TA, HR \& Pay systems and their longer\-term development as required to support simplification of compliance and risk control.
* To ensure periodic statutory deductions from pay are properly reconciled and returns completed by the due date.
* Interacts and works closely with other HR Operations teams and the wider HR Community to deliver best in practice services to the Business and GPO.

**What we are looking for**

* 3\+ years of experience in HR, Payroll, or Talent Acquisition compliance, with a strong understanding of statutory requirements, financial regulations, and Labour Law/CBA.
* Proven experience identifying and implementing compliance changes in line with evolving legislation and company policy.
* Experience ensuring statutory returns, payments, and periodic deductions are reconciled and submitted within deadlines.
* Strong process improvement mindset, with experience supporting continuous improvement, business continuity planning, and system simplification initiatives.
* Experience supporting or leading audits, with the ability to take ownership of complex, technical compliance and risk\-related issues.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to advise teams and partners on compliance and risk implications, while maintaining a workforce\-first approach.

**About Lonza**


At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30\+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.


Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.


Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Through bold discovery and cutting\-edge innovation, we lead an industry that is vital for the future of our planet: lighting. At Signify, you can shape tomorrow by building on our incredible 125\+ year legacy while working toward even bolder sustainability goals. Our culture of continuous learning, creativity, and commitment to diversity and inclusion empowers you to grow your skills and career.

  

Join us, and together, we’ll transform our industry, making a lasting difference for brighter lives and a better world.

 **More about the role**

 **Job profile Summary**


Acting as the operational engine of the Talent \& Learning function, the role partners closely with the HRS team to manage and evolve the Talent \& Learning Management System (Workday Learning) and learning partners, while championing a data\-driven culture through learning analytics, NPS measurement, and continuous improvement of case fulfilment rates.

**Key Areas of Responsibility**

**1\. Learning Analytics \& Insights**

* Own the end\-to\-end learning analytics framework, defining KPIs that connect talent and learning investment to business outcomes.
* Design and maintain dashboards (Workday, Power BI or equivalent) tracking completion rates, learner engagement, time\-to\-competency, and skills gap closure.
* Generate monthly and quarterly learning metrics reports for senior stakeholders, translating data into actionable recommendations.
* Conduct root\-cause analysis on drop\-off rates, low engagement, or underperforming programmes, presenting data\-backed improvement plans.
* Establish and maintain a learning analytics governance model, ensuring data integrity, consistency, and compliance with privacy regulations (GDPR).

**2\. Case Fulfilment \& Learning Operations**

* Define, monitor, and continuously improve case fulfilment SLAs, targeting industry\-leading response and resolution times.
* Build and manage standardised operating procedures (SOPs) for learning operations, ensuring consistency and scalability across geographies.
* Lead a team of Talent and Learning specialists, allocating workloads, managing escalations, and developing team capability.
* Partner with Talent and learning program managers, stakeholders to anticipate demand cycles and align operational capacity proactively.

**3\. Workday Learning Platform Management**

* Serve as the functional owner of Workday Talent \& Learning, governing configuration, content architecture, learner journeys, and system health.
* Collaborate with the HRIS/HR Technology team on system enhancements, releases, and integrations (e.g., Skills Cloud, TechWolf, Skillsoft Percipio).
* Drive platform adoption through targeted change management campaigns, user enablement, and stakeholder communications.
* Monitor platform performance metrics — login rates, course completion, mobile usage(if applicable) — and implement interventions to close gaps.
* Manage vendor relationships and SLAs for integrated content providers and LMS\-adjacent tools.

**4\. Learning NPS \& Learner Experience**

* Design and operationalise the Learning Net Promoter Score (NPS) measurement framework across all delivery modalities.
* Analyse NPS trends, verbatim feedback, and satisfaction data to surface systemic quality issues and prioritise improvements.
* Champion a learner\-first mindset across the team, embedding feedback loops at every stage of the learning lifecycle.
* Benchmark learning NPS internally and against external industry standards, setting targets aligned to function KPIs.

**5\. HR Technology Interface \& Integration**

* Act as the Talent \& Learning point of contact for the HRS team, representing learning requirements in system roadmap discussions.
* Translate business and learning needs into functional specifications for HR Tech projects, ensuring L\&D priorities are sequenced and delivered.
* Support implementation and UAT of new learning technology features, integrations, and releases.
* Champion data interoperability between Workday Learning and adjacent systems (performance management, skills platforms, employee listening tools).
* Stay current on emerging learning technology trends (AI\-powered learning, adaptive pathways, xAPI/LRS) and bring relevant innovations to the function.

**6\. Stakeholder Management \& Governance**

* Build trusted relationships with HRBPs, CoE leads, and other stakeholders to understand evolving learning needs and communicate fulfilment status.
* Represent learning operations in HR governance forums, providing regular performance updates and exception reporting.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives using data from analytics, NPS, and SLA performance.
* Manage the learning operations budget (where applicable), ensuring cost efficiency without compromising quality or learner experience.

**Critical Experiences \& Skills**

**Experiences**

* Master's degree in Human Resources, HR Technology, or a related field.
* Strong progressive experience in L\&D, with at least 8 years in a learning operations, analytics, or platform management role.
* Demonstrated hands\-on experience managing Workday Learning (configuration, catalogue management, reporting).
* Proven track record of designing and delivering learning analytics frameworks with measurable business impact.
* Experience managing case/request management processes with defined SLAs in a complex, matrixed organisation.
* Strong data literacy — comfortable working with dashboards, Excel/Power BI, and presenting insights to senior audiences.
* Experience with learning NPS or equivalent learner satisfaction measurement methodologies.

**Skills**

* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel , Power BI and dashboard creation
* Analytical Skills : Excellent problem\-solving abilities with demonstrated critical thinking
* Communication \& presentation skills:
	+ Strong presentation abilities with experience communicating insights to senior leaders
	+ Active listening skills with ability to understand stakeholder needs and translate them into analytical solutions
	+ Collaborative approach with ability to work cross\-functionally
* People management skills

**Preferred**

* Experience with HR technology integration projects involving Workday, TechWolf, Skillsoft, or similar platforms.
* Workday Learning certification or equivalent LMS administration qualification.
* Familiarity with skills\-based organisation design and skills taxonomy frameworks.
* Exposure to xAPI / LRS architecture and modern learning measurement standards.
* Experience in a global or multi\-regional L\&D function spanning multiple countries.
* Change management experience.
* Basic understanding of AI applications in HR (Generative AI, Agentic AI)

 **Everything we’ll do for you**

  

You can grow a lasting career here. We’ll encourage you, support you, and challenge you. We’ll help you learn and progress in a way that’s right for you, with coaching and mentoring along the way. We’ll listen to you too, because we see and value every one of our 27,000\+ people. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace fosters creativity, innovation, and a full spectrum of bright ideas. With a global workforce present in 70\+ countries, we are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where every voice is heard and valued, helping us all achieve more together.

  

Come join us, and together we can light up the future.

**Job Title: OPT Recruiter (US IT Staffing)**

**Location:** Habsiguda, Hyderabad, India (Onsite)

**Shift:** EST Zone (6:30 PM to 3:30 AM IST)

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time, Permanent

**Job Summary**

We are seeking an experienced and result driven **Bench Sales Recruiter** to join our talent acquisition team in Hyderabad. In this role, you will be responsible for sourcing, screening, and recruiting talented OPT (Optional Practical Training) and CPT candidates for various specialized IT roles across the United States. Working during US business hours, you will serve as a crucial bridge between talented consultants and our diverse client requirements, ensuring a steady pipeline of skilled IT professionals.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **End\-to\-End OPT Lifecycle Recruitment:** Actively source, screen, interview, and onboard qualified OPT/CPT candidates for various US\-based IT positions.
* **Strategic Sourcing:** Utilize premier job boards (Dice, Monster, LinkedIn, Indeed), university networks, and social media channels to discover and engage with passive and active technical talent.
* **Screening \& Assessment:** Conduct initial phone evaluations, assess technical capabilities, verify communication skills, and evaluate cultural fit against client mandates.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner closely with US\-based Account Managers and Sales teams to understand dynamic hiring requirements, client expectations, and fast\-moving job orders.
* **Relationship \& Pipeline Management:** Build and nurture a robust network of OPT candidates, maintaining long\-term relationships to swiftly fill current and future technical openings.
* **Immigration \& Coordination Support:** Guide candidates through client interview schedules, initial onboarding requirements, and coordinate closely with legal/HR teams regarding visa processing and compliance.
* **ATS \& Reporting:** Maintain detailed, real\-time records of candidates, pipelines, and recruitment activities within our internal tracking systems.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* **Experience:** Proven track record as a Technical Recruiter specializing in **OPT/CPT recruitment** within the US IT Staffing ecosystem.
* **Immigration Literacy:** Solid understanding of US immigration pathways, specifically OPT, CPT, STEM extensions, and H\-1B visa lifecycles.
* **Tools \& Portals:** Hands\-on proficiency with major US job portals (Dice, LinkedIn Recruiter, Monster, Indeed) and Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS).
* **Communication:** Exceptional verbal and written English communication skills, with a strong ability to build trust and negotiate effectively with candidates.
* **Shift Adaptability:** Ability to stay highly self\-motivated, organized, and productive during night shift hours.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience in Human Resources, Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field.

**What we Offer**

* A vibrant, collaborative, onsite workplace environment focused on professional growth and career advancement
* Highly competitive base salary supplemented by an aggressive, performance\-linked incentive structure.
* Medical and Life Insurance coverage for immediate family
* Free Transportation both pick \& drop for all employees provided for hassle\-free commuting.
* Fixed 5\-day work week (Monday to Friday) with weekends off \& stable shift timings

Pay: ₹300,000\.00 \- ₹600,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Manager, People Systems
description:
At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.


Join us as we create something extraordinary together.

**Job Overview:**


The Manager, People Systems provides leadership and direction for a team responsible for the maintenance, optimization, and strategic evolution of key People Systems platforms. With deep expertise in People systems and strong leadership capability, this role oversees a product vertical that may include multiple functional areas (e.g., Workday, Cornerstone SBX, etc.). This leader ensures operational excellence, drives process innovation, manages team capacity, and partners closely with People Team COEs and business leaders to translate strategic needs into scalable system solutions. The Manager serves as both a consultative expert and a people leader—developing talent, managing performance, and fostering an environment grounded in curiosity, agility, accountability, and continuous improvement.  



**Responsibilities**

* Provide direct supervision and guidance to Analysts and Sr. Analysts, assigning tasks, monitoring work, and ensuring high‑quality outcomes.

* Manage performance, including evaluations, timesheet approvals, and calibration processes.
* Build team capability and resilience; cultivate inclusion and value diverse perspectives.
* Drive engagement across the team and pods, ensuring alignment to departmental engagement initiatives.

**Operational Leadership \& Resource Management**

* Oversee capacity planning, ensuring pods are effectively resourced across product verticals.
* Serve as owner of Key and Non‑Key controls; ensure compliance and audit readiness.
* Monitor Salesforce queues to ensure SLAs are met and remove operational barriers.
* Maintain schedules and workflows; intervene when needed to resolve complex issues.
* Partner with Tech team on execution of enhancements and system‑level initiatives.
* Manage POs/BPOs and related invoicing processes; support broader budget planning.

**Strategic Consultation \& Stakeholder Partnership**

* Act as a liaison and primary contact for Business Product Owners, business partners, and People leaders.
* Provide strategic guidance on enhancement requests, system capabilities, best practices, and compliance considerations.
* Use data and KPIs to track performance, identify themes, and develop actionable operational plans.
* Breakdown complex problems and assign work to optimize team effectiveness.
* Confidently make decisions with transparency and accountability.

**Systems Expertise \& Product Leadership**

* Maintain deep functional and technical understanding of Workday, troubleshooting and solutioning fluidly across the platform.
* Monitor product roadmaps and advise partners on the applicability of new features.
* Understand system connection points, integration options, and downstream impacts.
* Lead or support the design, configuration, and delivery of complex system solutions.

**Strategic Agility \& Continuous Improvement**

* Lead with curiosity, humility, and accountability; model resilience in ambiguous situations.
* Establish and manage processes that enable continuous review and improvement of efficiency.
* Utilize the LPL Values to drive consistency, transparency, and continuous improvement.
* Apply business storytelling—written and verbal—to articulate strategy, rationale, and value of solutions.

**Strategic Problem Solving \& Decision Making**

* Lead innovative thinking to simplify, optimize, and problem‑solve complex challenges.
* Use strong analytical capability to gather facts, identify root causes, and develop creative solutions.
* Benchmark against best‑in‑class approaches and collect feedback to measure solution effectiveness.

**What are we looking for?**


We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast\-paced, team\-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates **pursue greatness**, **act with integrity**, and are **driven to help our clients succeed**. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we **win together** and **create and share joy** in our work.

**Requirements:**

* 5–6\+ years of HR systems experience with advanced depth in Workday.
* Prior experience supervising or leading a technical team.
* Strong consultative, problem‑solving, and analytical capability.
* Proven ability to lead change, manage complex projects, and communicate effectively to diverse audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to build relationships across teams and levels.

**Preferences****:**

* Experience managing Cornerstone SBX, or a similar enterprise LMS system.
* Experience with agile methodologies, or product‑based operating models.

 **Core Competencies****:**

* Able to make quick decisions and resolve complex technical problems
* Ability to manage through shift changes and effectively transition open and unresolved issues.
* Ability to adapt, learn new technologies, develop new processes, and improve procedures.
* Good documentation skills.
* Ability to write, read, interpret, and edit complex documents and correspondence with team members and stakeholders.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work peak, off\-peak, weekend, and holiday shifts.
* Ability to communicate and respond to communication effectively with client, associates, and stakeholders.
* Ability to perform problem\-solving, use logic and creative thought processes to resolve complex technical problems.

title: Head of Human Resources
description:
HR Manager – HR Operations, Talent Acquisition \& Cross\-Border Compliance (India \& Saudi Arabia)
 








**Job Summary** 




 We are seeking an experienced and strategic HR professional to lead HR Operations and Talent Acquisition across India and Saudi Arabia. The role requires a strong blend of recruitment expertise, HR operations excellence, labor law compliance, employee relations, and policy management. The ideal candidate will bring 15\+ years of progressive HR experience, with proven capability in managing cross\-border HR operations, scaling teams, and supporting business growth in dynamic environments.
 







 The candidate should also have experience working closely with attorneys/legal counsels on HR policy drafting, employment contracts, disciplinary matters, compliance frameworks, and labor law\-related documentation across multiple jurisdictions.
 







**Key Responsibilities** 









**Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning** 



* Manage the end\-to\-end recruitment lifecycle including sourcing, screening, interviewing, offer management, and onboarding
* Partner with business leaders and hiring managers to understand workforce planning and hiring requirements
* Develop and execute effective sourcing strategies through job portals, referrals, social media, and recruitment networks
* Lead hiring initiatives across India and Saudi Arabia, including high\-volume and niche hiring
* Ensure a seamless and positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment process
* Track and analyze recruitment metrics such as time\-to\-hire, cost\-per\-hire, and quality of hire



**HR Operations \& Employee Lifecycle Management** 



* Oversee complete employee lifecycle processes including onboarding, confirmations, transfers, promotions, and exits
* Manage employee records, HR documentation, attendance, leave management, and payroll coordination
* Maintain HRIS systems and ensure employee data accuracy and confidentiality
* Support audits and maintain audit\-ready HR records and documentation
* Streamline HR processes to improve operational efficiency and scalability



  





  





**Compliance \& Labor Law Management** 



* Ensure compliance with Indian labor laws and Saudi labor regulations including Saudization, Iqama, GOSI, visa, and work permit requirements
* Coordinate with PROs and external agencies for employee documentation, visas, and expatriate workforce management
* Work closely with attorneys and legal counsels on HR policy drafting, employment agreements, disciplinary procedures, compliance matters, investigations, and labor law documentation
* Maintain and update HR policies, SOPs, employee handbooks, and compliance frameworks across regions
* Ensure adherence to internal policies, statutory regulations, and corporate governance standards



**Compensation, Benefits \& Performance Management** 



* Manage salary structures, compensation revisions, benchmarking, and benefits administration
* Oversee expatriate compensation, allowances, and per diem structures
* Drive performance appraisal cycles, goal\-setting frameworks, and employee feedback processes
* Support leadership in talent development, succession planning, and retention initiatives



**Employee Relations \& Engagement** 



* Serve as the primary HR point of contact for employee queries and support
* Handle employee grievances, disciplinary actions, investigations, and conflict resolution
* Foster a positive and inclusive work culture across locations
* Lead employee engagement and retention initiatives



**HR Reporting \& Analytics** 



* Generate HR dashboards, MIS reports, and analytics for leadership review
* Provide data\-driven insights to support HR and business decision\-making
* Monitor key HR metrics and recommend process improvements







**Key Requirements** 



* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field
* 15\+ years of progressive experience in HR Operations and Talent Acquisition
* Strong exposure to HR operations in both India and Saudi Arabia
* In\-depth knowledge of Indian labor laws and Saudi labor regulations
* Experience managing cross\-border and expatriate workforce
* Proven experience working with attorneys/legal teams on HR policy drafting, compliance, contracts, and employee relations matters
* Hands\-on experience with HRIS platforms and recruitment tools
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and leadership skills
* Excellent problem\-solving, analytical, and organizational capabilities
* Ability to thrive in fast\-paced and dynamic business environments







**Preferred Skills** 



* Experience in scaling teams and managing high\-volume recruitment
* Strong analytical mindset with data\-driven decision\-making capabilities
* Exposure to multinational or multi\-location organizations
* Ability to align HR strategy with overall business objectives
* Strong process orientation with a focus on operational excellence

The DXG division of Wolters Kluwer co\-creates state\-of\-the\-art digital solutions with our businesses around the world. The DXG mandate is to grow revenue in the company’s digital products through innovation in, and adoption of, advanced technologies and tools to meet and further anticipate customer needs. Engaging CoE partners as appropriate, responsible to diagnose, identify scope of change, and identify interventions needed to improve organizational effectiveness. Assist with design of future state changes (people, process, and structure), supporting change plans and working with employees to implement.

* Stay abreast of industry best practices, identifying areas of improvement and recommending and/or implementing those best practices to support the corporate goals.

* Support managers to consistently upgrade talent by developing and implementing processes specifically related to assessing and managing talent, by taking a leadership role in recruiting and staffing, by coaching leaders and overseeing performance improvement, and by providing support for appropriate actions.

description:
Job Overview
  
  

**Role Profile :** SAP Technical \& Platform Lead
  
Role
  
The SAP Technical \& Platform Lead will serve as the hands\-on engineering and operational leader for Osttra’s SAP implementation. This role is responsible for the end\-to\-end operational lifecycle, system connectivity, and technical management of the SAP platform, while also overseeing the broader corporate technology suite including Dayforce (HCM). Based in Gurugram, the position ensures that internal transactional architectures are highly stable, automated, and seamlessly integrated with upstream and downstream boundary applications.
  
This is an execution\-focused, infrastructure\-aware engineering leadership role. The successful candidate will blend strategic vendor coordination with deep SAP platform expertise, directly managing a small, agile local team of 4–5 engineering professionals covering both SAP and Dayforce platforms, alongside overseeing third\-party Application Management Services (AMS) vendor support.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
Team Leadership \& Vendor Governance
  
* Team Direction: Direct, coach, and mentor a core local team of 4–5 technical professionals in India covering the SAP and Dayforce platforms, translating global roadmaps into executable daily sprints.
* AMS Vendor Accountability: Manage day\-to\-day delivery and hold Application Management Services (AMS) partners and third\-party vendors strictly accountable to contractually agreed technical SLAs.
* SAP RISE Coordination: Manage daily interactions with SAP's cloud teams regarding the SAP RISE hosted managed cloud environment, coordinating infrastructure administration, routine patching, and logging Service Requests (SRs).


Platform Management
  
* Service Management: Directly responsible for day to day IT Service Management \- ensuring there is a proactive and robust process for managing incidents, problems and change.
* Connectivity Management: Own and manage the overall technical boundaries, system connectivity, and network infrastructure remaining directly in Osttra's control.
* Environment Control: Maintain the health, security, and access controls of non\-production integration and testing environments to ensure zero disruption to live operations.


Integration, Middleware \& Data Integrity
  
* Middleware Architecture: Oversee data mapping, file transfer (FTP) capabilities, and secure data flows between SAP and peripheral applications utilizing the SAP Integration Suite (SIS).
* Ledger Boundary Control: Secure and optimize automated data ingestion points and APIs on the financial ledger side where upstream transactional or billing data enters the accounting environment.
* Bespoke Cloud Support: Monitor and maintain external integration utilities, such as the Java\-based Vertex SAP Integration Component (SIC) hosted on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) virtual machines.


Technical Governance \& Defect Resolution
  
* Advanced Troubleshooting: Act as the ultimate technical escalation point for complex platform defects, utilizing deep database and coding insights to resolve issues standard vendor or AMS support cannot easily fix.
* Data Optimization: Apply architectural understanding of SAP to actively optimize system queries and code objects.
* Compliance Guardrails: Ensure all technical configurations, security permissions, and master data structures strictly align with global data privacy frameworks (e.g., GDPR for HR data) and internal financial controls.


Required Skills \& Qualifications
  
Technical Expertise

title: Area HR
description:
**About the Company** 




  





 Aditya Birla Lifestyle Brands Limited (ABLBL), a part of the Aditya Birla Group, is a leading branded apparel company with a comprehensive portfolio of marquee lifestyle brands.
 



 As of March 31, 2025, the Company operates a retail footprint of over 4\.6 million sq. ft., comprising 3,253 exclusive brand outlets, presence across 38,000\+ multi\-brand outlets, and over 7,000 shop\-in\-shops in department stores across the country.
 



 The Company’s brand portfolio includes India’s most established and trusted names – Louis Philippe, Van Heusen, Allen Solly, and Peter England – each with a legacy of over 25 years.
 



 These brands have consistently delivered sustained growth, driven by a sharp focus on design\-led innovation, category expansion, and operational excellence across product lines spanning formal, casual, and occasion wear.
 



 ABLBL has built a strong presence in the innerwear and athleisure market through Van Heusen Innerwear, which has rapidly scaled its distribution network across India. The Company’s portfolio is further enhanced through strategic partnerships with leading international brands including Simon Carter, American Eagle and Reebok. American Eagle has emerged as one of India’s most preferred premium denim brands, while Reebok – transitioned under the Company’s management in 2022 – has expanded its footprint across multiple channels. Simon Carter continues to strengthen its position in the premium menswear segment through its distinctive design language and curated collections.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 The Area HR will act as a strategic and operational HR partner for retail store operations across the assigned geography. The role is responsible for managing the
 **entire employee lifecycle of frontline retail staff** 
 —from hiring to exit—while ensuring high employee engagement, compliance, and seamless HR service delivery.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Talent Acquisition \& Onboarding** 



* Drive end\-to\-end recruitment for store\-level roles (Sales Associates, Store Managers, Supervisors, etc.)
* Manage talent pipelines through vendors, job portals, walk\-ins, and local sourcing
* Ensure timely onboarding and smooth joining experience
* Coordinate induction and orientation programs for new hires



**2\. Employee Lifecycle Management** 



* Handle complete employee lifecycle:
 **Hire → Onboard → Develop → Retain → Exit**
* Maintain employee records, documentation, and HRIS updates
* Monitor probation confirmations, transfers, promotions, and separations
* Ensure smooth offboarding and exit formalities



**3\. Performance Management** 



* Support implementation of performance appraisal processes for retail staff
* Track performance metrics (sales KPIs, productivity, etc.) in collaboration with business teams
* Assist in identifying high performers and managing underperformance



**4\. Employee Engagement \& Retention** 



* Plan and execute engagement initiatives across stores
* Conduct regular store visits and employee connects
* Address employee grievances and workplace concerns
* Drive retention strategies for frontline workforce



**5\. Attendance, Payroll \& Compliance** 



* Oversee attendance, leave management, and payroll inputs
* Ensure adherence to statutory compliances (Shops \& Establishment Act, labour laws, PF, ESIC, etc.)
* Support audits and ensure documentation readiness
* Monitor adherence to company HR policies and processes



**6\. Training \& Development** 



* Identify skill gaps and coordinate training for store employees
* Facilitate induction and refresher training programs
* Support capability building initiatives for front\-end staff



**7\. HR Operations \& Reporting** 



* Manage HR dashboards and workforce analytics (attrition, hiring TAT, absenteeism, etc.)
* Provide regular reports and insights to stakeholders
* Improve HR processes and drive efficiency at store level



**8\. Business Partnering** 



* Act as a bridge between store operations and corporate HR
* Support store managers on people\-related matters
* Drive a strong people culture aligned with business goals



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 



* MBA / PGDM in HR or related field
* 4–8 years of HR experience, preferably in Retail/QSR/Frontline workforce management
* Experience handling high\-volume hiring and field HR operations

title: Human Resources Coordinator
description:
We are looking for HR Coordinators who can act as the face of the organization throughout the candidate journey. At CynLr, we believe alignment begins before a person joins, not after. The first interaction a candidate has with us shapes how they understand the company, the role, and the founder’s intent. In this role, you will do the heavy lifting of translating that intent into clear, thoughtful, and compelling communication across every stage of hiring and onboarding.
 



**About the Role** 




 As an HR Coordinator, your primary contribution will be to shape how candidates experience CynLr from the moment they discover an opportunity to the moment they join. You will support hiring teams in carrying the organization’s impression in an insightful, consistent, and high\-context manner. This role combines recruitment coordination, employer branding, stakeholder communication, process discipline, and early\-stage organizational alignment.
 



**What You Will Do** 




 • Applicant stage: Adapt job descriptions to the requirements and audience of each platform, including LinkedIn, the company website, and other relevant channels, to improve discoverability and attractiveness. Research candidate demographics, skill combinations, and platform behavior to determine where and when to publish roles for maximum relevance.
 



 • Campus recruitment: Support high\-coordination campus hiring efforts where the objective is not volume but identifying the right candidate in a difficult market. Help manage large applicant pools, communication flows, institution coordination, and branding touchpoints across campuses.
 



 • Candidate stage: Send and coordinate emails for tests and interviews, share preparation details, ensure support team availability, maintain test records and reports, and contribute to the design of filtering criteria using available assessment data.
 



 • Selected candidate stage: Manage candidate confirmations, coordinate interview logistics with relevant stakeholders, maintain interview performance records, and ensure timely follow\-up communication for all candidates who participate in the process.
 



 • Onboarding stage: Log new joiner details into internal systems, generate employee IDs, coordinate with IT for asset issuance, collect required documents, and administer internal and statutory induction programs.
 



 • Employer impression and communication: Act as a consistent and professional point of contact for candidates, helping remove communication roadblocks and ensuring that the organization’s values, expectations, and founder’s impression are carried meaningfully throughout the journey.
 



**Job Requirements** 




 • Domain and tool knowledge: Understanding of business operations, communication fundamentals, HR operations, employer branding, and negotiation. Familiarity with major job portals, applicant tracking systems, payroll software, and strong working knowledge of MS Office tools.
 



 • Core skills: Strong organization, documentation, and coordination skills, with the ability to interface effectively with external stakeholders. Excellent professional communication and negotiation skills, an understanding of human psychology, and the ability to manage expectations with maturity and clarity.
 



 • Behavioral tendencies: Critical thinking, responsibility, versatility, resourcefulness, availability, thoroughness, and strong attention to detail.
 



**What Success Looks Like** 




 • Roles are clearly defined, market\-informed, and aligned with the company’s stage and business needs.
 



 • Hiring processes are structured, candidate\-centric, and continuously improving through data and feedback.
 



 • Strong talent pipelines are built across experienced hiring, campus hiring, and institutional partnerships.
 



 • Employer messaging resonates with the right candidates across different talent segments and platforms.
 



 • Cross\-functional hiring teams are supported with clarity, responsiveness, and strategic insight.
 



**Who We Are Looking For** 




 • You are deeply curious and prefer understanding the problem before applying templates or assumptions.
 



 • You are action\-oriented and enjoy building, coordinating, and improving systems rather than only advising on them.
 



 • You think analytically and can connect business context, talent strategy, and market behavior.
 



 • You communicate clearly and can work effectively across founders, hiring managers, HR teams, branding teams, and operations stakeholders.
 



 • You are excited by startup environments where roles evolve quickly and thoughtful hiring can create outsized impact.
 



**Who You Will Work With** 




 You will work closely with the HR and Talent Management team for execution. You will also collaborate extensively with Branding and Tech teams to shape role narratives and hiring journeys, and partner with Operations and Finance teams where planning and budget considerations are involved.
 



**How Your Career Progresses** 




 We see this role as the starting point of a long\-term journey into Human Resources Management at CynLr. In a startup environment, the company evolves quickly and the needs of the organization expand continuously. Over time, this role can open pathways into specialized areas within HR, including talent acquisition, people operations, employer branding, onboarding, and broader organizational development.
 



**Why Join Us** 




 If you are excited by the idea of building hiring systems that are strategic, analytical, and deeply human, this role offers the chance to shape how a company discovers and develops talent from the ground up. You will help define not just who we hire, but how we think about roles, talent markets, candidate journeys, and long\-term organizational growth.

description:
Bengaluru, Karnataka
  
Job Summary
  
  

Position Overview
  
We are looking for an energetic and detail‑oriented Application Support Engineer (L2 \+ L3\) to support enterprise productivity and collaboration platform maintenance in an SRE‑driven operating model. This role combines first‑line and second‑line support, including incident troubleshooting, configuration management, platform‑aware tasks, stability checks, and ongoing optimization activities.
  
The ideal candidate will help ensure application stability, performance, and continuous improvement while supporting MS O365 services, MS Power Platform, MS Project, MS SharePoint, MS SQL, and related enterprise tools.
  
This is an excellent role for freshers or early‑career engineers eager to grow into SRE, Platform DevOps, or advanced application engineering roles.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
1\. Incident \& Service Request Handling (L2 \+ L3 Scope)
  
  

Monitor workflow failures, access issues, integration alerts, and platform dashboards; acknowledge and respond within defined SLAs/SLOs.
  
Perform initial troubleshooting using service logs, SQL checks, SharePoint validations, Power Platform flow history, and runbooks.
  
Restore services by executing recommended actions (workflow reruns, permission corrections, cache refreshes, scheduled job restarts).
  
Escalate complex issues to senior engineers or development teams with clear documentation.
  
Maintain accurate incident notes, timelines, and resolution steps.
  
  

2\. Application Source Code \& Content Operations
  
  

Support parameter updates, permissions, site configurations, workflow changes, and platform settings across O365 and related systems.
  
Assist in solution deployments during release windows, including pre‑checks, validations, and rollback support.
  
Maintain Power Apps/Flows, SharePoint lists/libraries, FileMaker components, and configuration items within version‑controlled repositories.
  
Execute tasks to keep application components current, optimized, and stable.
  
  

3\. Application Stability \& Daily Operational Checks
  
  

Perform scheduled health checks, workflow monitoring, integration validations, and log analysis.
  
Ensure smooth functioning of SharePoint sites, Power Platform automations, MS Project components, and SQL‑supported application operations.
  
Validate records, capacity thresholds, scheduled jobs, backups, and overall service health metrics.
  
  

4\. SRE‑Conscious Operations \& Automation Participation
  
  

Follow SRE practices such as runbook execution, error‑budget awareness, and RCA discipline.
  
Identify recurring issues and propose automation or runbook improvements.
  
Contribute to Knowledge Base (KB) articles and troubleshooting guides.
  
Support continuous improvement initiatives across reliability, observability, and operational efficiency.
  
  

5\. Tools \& Platforms Exposure
  
  

**Enterprise Tools:** MS O365, MS Power Platform, MS Project, MS SharePoint, MS SQL, FileMaker – troubleshooting workflows, integrations, and configurations.
  
**Utilities:** Dynatrace monitoring, Figma for UI documentation, Confluence for knowledge management, Honeywell Voice tools, and IBM Rational components.
  
**Change Management:** Git, Azure Repos, or equivalent version‑control tools.
  
**Monitoring Tools:** Dynatrace dashboards, O365 admin insights, SharePoint health pages, and SQL monitoring outputs.
  
**Freeware/Open‑source tools:** Git (documentation), Postman/Notepad\+\+ (auxiliary), curl/OpenSSL for API simulations.
  
  

Skill Requirements
  
  

Mandatory Requirements
  
2\- 4 years of experience in application support, production support, or software maintenance.
  
  

**Basic understanding of:**  

O365 services, SharePoint sites, and workspace behaviors
  
Power Platform flows, apps, and automation components
  
SQL basics – ability to run simple SELECT queries
  
FileMaker structures and data objects
  
Workflow reruns, configuration checks, and integration failure investigation
  
  

Familiarity with O365 admin tools, Power Platform monitoring, and versioning utilities.
  
Strong analytical and troubleshooting mindset.
  
Willingness to work in rotational shifts and learn rapidly.
  
  

Good to Have
  
  

Exposure to Dynatrace monitoring, SharePoint Online admin tools, or enterprise dashboards.
  
Knowledge of automation scripting (PowerShell/Python) for operations.
  
Understanding of solution optimization, workflow performance basics, and data indexing.
  
Awareness of ITIL processes (Incident, Change, Problem).
  
Basic understanding of integrations and log/dump analysis.
  
  

Soft Skills
  
  

Strong communication and documentation skills.
  
Ability to think logically and solve problems under pressure.
  
Proactive learning attitude and adaptability.
  
Team player with a customer‑first mindset.
  
  

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  
  

Incident response \& resolution speed (MTTA/MTTR).
  
Ticket quality and adherence to SLAs.
  
Accuracy and completeness of documentation and runbooks.
  
Contribution to stability improvements and SLO adherence.
  
Participation in automation and process optimization efforts."

title: Co-Founder and Medical Doctor (MBBS)
description:
About Mednevo

Mednevo is an early\-stage AI healthcare startup revolutionizing \*primary healthcare\* in India. We combine \*cutting\-edge AI technology\* with a genuine patient\-first approach to deliver accessible, personalized, and high\-quality care. Our platform integrates \*on\-demand virtual consultations, in\-home doctor visits, proactive wellness monitoring, and AI\-powered tools for interactive consultations, patient education, and personalized health insights.

We are particularly focused on making quality care — including pediatric care — more efficient, affordable, and scalable across urban and semi\-urban India. As a small, high\-impact team (2\-10 people), we move fast and solve real problems: reducing wait times, supporting clinical decisions with AI, improving outcomes for families and children, and building the future of intelligent healthcare delivery.

The Opportunity We are looking for a passionate Medical Doctor to join as a Co\-Founder. This is not a traditional clinical job — it is a founding leadership role where you will shape the clinical vision, build the product alongside AI engineers, and help scale a mission\-driven healthcare ecosystem. You will bring real\-world medical expertise (especially in pediatrics) to ensure our AI tools are clinically accurate, safe, empathetic, and truly useful for Indian families and doctors.

Key Responsibilities **⁠ ⁠**

**Clinical Leadership \& Product Vision: Co\-define the medical strategy and clinical pathways, with special focus on pediatric care, primary health, preventive wellness, and common childhood conditions.** ⁠ ⁠AI \+ Medicine Integration: Work closely with AI engineers to train, validate, and refine AI models for symptom assessment, triage, personalized advice, and decision support. Provide clinical oversight to ensure safety and accuracy. **⁠ ⁠**
