title: Vertiv - Penetration Tester ( 0-0 yrs )
description:
**Job Description**
 Job Description
   

  

 Join a High\-Performance Culture That Drives Innovation and Excellence
   

  

 At Vertiv, we don’t just hire talent—we cultivate leaders who drive innovation and engage teams to push the limits of what’s possible. As a global leader in critical digital infrastructure, we are scaling up to meet the demands of AI, data centers, and next\-gen technology—and we need bold, high\-performing individuals like YOU to take us to the next level.
   

  

 Why Vertiv?
   

  

* High\-Performance Culture: We empower you to think big, execute with excellence, and deliver impact. Our performance\-driven mindset rewards those who challenge the status quo and drive meaningful change. Over 50 CEO Awards are given annually to recognize top talent moving the needle forward.
* Leadership Without Limits: Leadership at Vertiv goes beyond just titles—it’s about accountability, trust, and ownership. Our leaders engage and drive with collaboration, innovation, and customer\-centric thinking, setting the foundation for an action\-focused culture.
* Limitless Growth \& Learning: We believe in continuous development. Whether through rotational programs or high\-impact projects, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your expertise and grow your career.
* A Place for Everyone: Our commitment to inclusion ensures that all employee’s unique strengths and perspectives are valued. Your voice matters, your growth is prioritized, and your success is celebrated.


 Role Overview
   

  

 The Analyst II \| Application and Product Security is responsible for conducting security pen testing, monitoring, and auditing within a dynamic global organization. The products under test will have the coverage of embedded devices and cloud services. The Senior Pen Tester should have exposure to embedded devices as well as cloud services (AWS/Azure). Some of the products will be white box tests while others will be total black box engagements. A successful Senior Pen Tester will be able to take the product and evaluate the weak points in the design and implementation and focus in on those weaknesses to find security gaps. All the findings by the Senior Pen Tester will need to be clearly documented and relayed to the design team for mitigation. The Senior Pen Tester will need to be very versatile in their attack vectors and their knowledge of exploits. The ideal candidate will be well experienced in a broad range of attack vectors across a wide spectrum of devices from small, embedded devices to wide and complex cloud ecosystems.
   

  

 They will be responsible for interfacing with engineering teams to conduct security testing, auditing and should be able to explain the findings. They will be responsible for ensuring that engineering teams stay in compliance with the security expectations of the global organization. The Senior Pen Tester will be expected to stay current with the latest security threats and attack vectors that can be deployed against the product portfolio. They should also have experience in communicating clearly and concisely the findings of these activities to an audience.
   

  

 The testing activity and methodology deployed to confirm compliance is guided but expected to be enhanced by the Senior Pen Tester. The Senior Pen Tester will be expected to use their knowledge and experience to further develop internal testing processes and procedures.
   

  

 Job Responsibilities
   

  

**Duties**
 In addition to performing internal application and product security assessments the Analyst II \| Application and Product Security will be expected to support response to possible breaches of security based on newly disclosed information. Other key duties include:
   

  

* Conduct security evaluation and threat assessments of embedded systems, mobile applications, web applications
* Conduct research for the purposes of finding new vulnerabilities and enhancing existing capabilities

If you’re excited to learn, grow, and leave your mark on our fast\-growing organization, C2FO may be the place for you.
  
About C2FO
  
Headquartered in Kansas City, USA, C2FO has more than 500 employees worldwide, with operations throughout North America, Europe, India, Asia Pacific, and Australia. C2FO is the world’s largest on\-demand working capital platform. Our mission is to ensure every business has the capital needed to thrive and we have delivered more than $400\+ billion in funding to businesses since our founding. How do we do this? description:
**Must have requirements:**

**Professional presentation —** a polished, presentable and professional appearance, with good grooming and business etiquette, suited to a client\-facing founder’s\-office role.

This is a high\-trust, high\-variety, front\-of\-house support role working directly with the Founder’s / CEO’s Office. You will be a dependable, presentable point of coordination for the leadership office — keeping the back office running smoothly (administration, HR operations and day\-to\-day accounts/compliance support) while partnering with leadership on new and innovative projects that arise in the routine course of business.

It is ideal for a sharp, organised and well\-presented person with excellent English who enjoys variety, takes ownership across functions, is comfortable with ambiguity and a fast pace, and wants close exposure to how a business is run from the top. You will work alongside the founder/CEO and coordinate with clients, banks, auditors, vendors, candidates and external partners. Prior accounting knowledge is a plus but not essential — guidance, tools and training are provided.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Founder’s / CEO’s Office \& Special Projects**

· Work directly with the Founder’s / CEO’s Office on new and innovative initiatives that come up in the routine course of business.

· Research, scope and help execute special projects across functions — from process improvements to new business initiatives.

· Prepare briefs, presentations and background research to support leadership decision\-making.

· Track project milestones, follow up with internal teams and external stakeholders, and drive tasks to closure.

· Bring structure to open\-ended, fast\-moving assignments and act as a reliable coordination point for the leadership office.

**2\. Administration \& Front\-Office Coordination**

· Coordinate meetings with clients and external stakeholders; manage calendars, reminders and follow\-ups.

· Receive and host visitors and clients with a professional, presentable and courteous front\-office presence.

· Oversee office upkeep, vendor coordination, AMC management, utility payments and procurement of supplies, devices and services.

· Maintain documentation for NDAs, MoUs, agreements and renewal schedules; manage dispatch, courier and records.

· Support senior management with documentation, presentations and coordination tasks as required.

**3\. HR Operations \& Support**

· Coordinate with external HR consultants/agencies to source profiles for open roles.

· Schedule interviews, manage candidate communication and track hiring progress.

· Manage onboarding — offer letters, documentation, ID creation, policy orientation and induction support.

· Maintain employee records, leave registers, attendance and HR documentation.

· Assist in drafting HR policies, updating SOPs and ensuring consistent HR administration.

**4\. Accounting \& Compliance Support (transaction volume: low to very low — knowledge is good to have; training provided)**

· Raise and share client invoices and follow up for timely fee collection.

· Record routine accounting entries and support periodic bank reconciliations.

· Support monthly payroll, GST/TDS payments and return filings, with guidance.

· Coordinate with banks and auditors; provide data for statutory audits.

· Maintain accounting software (Tally or equivalent) and prepare basic MIS — receivables, payables and cash\-flow trackers.

· Keep organised files for financial transactions, agreements and statutory correspondence.

**(Essential)**

· **Pune\-based, on\-site —** open to Pune\-based candidates only. This is an on\-site role at Erandwane, Pune (no relocation support).

· **Computer\-literate —** proficient in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and quick to learn business tools.

· **Organised \& detail\-oriented —** strong attention to detail, organisation and ownership across parallel tasks.

· **Trustworthy —** discretion and integrity when handling confidential financial, business and personnel information.

**Good to Have (Not Essential)**

· **Accounting knowledge —** working knowledge of accounting and related areas — Tally (or similar), GST, TDS and payroll/statutory basics.

· **Commerce background —** a background in Commerce, Accounting or Business Administration.

· **Founder’s\-office exposure —** prior experience supporting a founder’s/CEO’s office or in an EA\-plus / chief\-of\-staff capacity.

· **Audit / startup exposure —** exposure to statutory audits, or experience in a startup / small\-business / multi\-functional generalist setup.

· **Marketing support —** basic content\-writing and social\-media coordination for light marketing support.

**Core Competencies**

· Ownership and reliability across multiple, parallel workstreams.

· Comfort with ambiguity and a fast pace — turning open\-ended asks into clear outcomes.

· Fast learner who can switch between special projects, administration, HR and accounts support.

· High trustworthiness and discretion with sensitive business and personnel information.

· A proactive, problem\-solving and continuous\-improvement mindset.

**Why This Role**

· Direct, day\-to\-day exposure to the Founder’s / CEO’s Office and how the business is run.

· Broad ownership across operations, HR, special projects and accounts — rare this early in a career.

· A strong launchpad to grow into operations, finance or a chief\-of\-staff track.

**Location \& Work Setup**

On\-site at Erandwane, Pune (Pune\-based candidates only). Standard working hours: Monday–Saturday, 9:30 AM – 6:30 PM.

title: HR Executive
description:
RaK's Pallikkoodam subscribes to the 21st century learning principles and is a student\-centered, future\-focused, coeducational day school. Creativity and Critical thinking, combined with developing the strength of character is at the core of our programme. The school is also grounded in the 21st\-century educational principles.

For more information, please visit https://www.rakspallikkoodam.com

***DESCRIPTION***

We are seeking an experienced, empathetic, and highly organized **HR Executive** to carry out our human resources functions. Unlike a corporate environment, an international school thrives on a community\-centric culture where empathy, patience, and relationship\-building are just as important as policy enforcement.

In this role, you will handle the entire employee lifecycle—from attracting top\-tier global educators to handling complex payroll, compliance, and employee grievances. To succeed, you must be a champion of confidential data management, possess exceptional English communication skills, and understand the fluid, event\-driven calendar of an educational institution.

***KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:***

* **End\-to\-End Recruitment \& Onboarding:** Handle the full talent acquisition cycle for academic, administrative, and support staff. This includes sourcing international and local educators, conducting background and reference checks, managing visa/work permit processes, and designing welcoming orientation programs.
* **Policy Formulation \& Implementation:** Update and implement school HR policies, staff handbooks, and codes of conduct. Ensure all policies align with local labor laws, international educational standards, and child safeguarding protocols.
* **Payroll \& Benefits Administration:** Handle monthly payroll processing, tax deductions, social security, health insurance, and end\-of\-service benefits with zero margin for error.
* **PF \& ESI:** Deep understanding of statutory compliance regarding PF and ESI, with proven expertise in handling registrations, monthly contributions, and documentation directly through the official portals.
* **Employee Relations \& Grievance Handling:** Act as the primary point of contact for staff grievances, conflicts, and personal queries. Mediate issues with high emotional intelligence, escalate it to the respective Leads / HODs / HOS and ensuring fair resolutions while maintaining a harmonious school climate.
* **Data Management \& HRIS:** Maintain meticulous, up\-to\-date physical and digital employee records (contracts, performance reviews, credentials). Fully manage the school’s HRIS (Human Resources Information System) to ensure data accuracy and generate insightful HR reports.
* **Confidentiality \& Compliance:** Handle sensitive information—such as salary structures, legal disputes, performance issues, and medical records—with the utmost discretion and integrity.

***REQUIRED QUALIFICATION \& EXPERIENCE:***

* **3 to 5 years of progressive HR experience, with a minimum of 2 years specifically within an international school setting is mandatory.** (Experience navigating expatriate teacher recruitment and visa regulations is highly preferred).
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
* **Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.**
* **Must have atleast 2 years of experience in statutory compliance regarding PF, ESI and navigating their portals.**
* Hands\-on experience working with HRIS software and payroll systems.
* Exceptional organizational skills for maintaining foolproof soft and hard copy filing systems.
* Strong understanding of local labor laws and employment regulations governing educational institutions.

***CULTURAL FIT \& WORKING ATTRIBUTES:***

* A deep understanding that a school environment requires an approachable, flexible, sensitive and nurturing HR presence rather than a rigid, corporate corporate approach.
* Ability to adapt to the school calendar. This includes preparing for peak hiring seasons (usually prior to the new academic year) and being flexible with working hours during major school events, orientations, or parent\-teacher weeks.
* The ability to remain calm, objective, and supportive under pressure while dealing with sensitive personal or professional staff issues.

Applicants **without relevant qualification and experience** are requested **NOT TO APPLY** and will not be considered. **Freshers** are requested **NOT to apply.** The candidates are requested **NOT TO CALL THE SCHOOL.**

title: System Administrator
description:
**About CynLr** 




  





 Just like a baby’s brain, CynLr Visual Intelligence stack makes Robots to
 **instinctively see \& pick any object under any ambience, without any training. Demo Video** 




 Today, a robot that can fit a screw into a nut without slipping a thread, doesn’t exist. Imagine what it would take for a robot to
 **assemble a Smartphone** 
 or a car by putting together 1000s of parts with varied shapes and weights, all in random orientations. Thus, factories become complex, needing heavy customization of their environment.
 



 CynLr\-enabled visual robots intuitively learn to handle even unknown objects, on\-the\-fly, eliminating the need for rigid fixtures, pre\-training, or environment customization. This enables an universal alternative to custom automation thus simplifying factory lines into modular LEGO\-like micro\-factories that can be rapidly reconfigured as products change.
 



 At the core of CynLr lies a fundamentally new approach to machine vision. Unlike conventional vision systems that rely on image recognition and heuristics, CynLr’ s Vision and ML stacks are deeply inspired by neuroscience, modelling how biological vision understands shape, geometry, and interaction rather than appearance alone. To support this, CynLr builds its hardware, sensors, compute pipelines, and learning stacks from scratch, tightly coupling perception, decision\-making, and action.
 



 This integration allows CynLr to operate in conditions that defeat traditional automation: variable lighting, cluttered environments, unknown objects, and high precision manipulation, unlocking automation use cases that have remained unsolved for decades. By rethinking vision as an intelligent, adaptive sense rather than a static tool, CynLr is redefining how robots perceive, reason, and interact with the physical world.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




  





 As a
 *System Administrator at CynLr* 
 , you will design, build, and evolve IT infrastructure, processes, and practices that support research, product development, and operations, while ensuring efficient, secure, and sustainable usage. Process for the sake of process will not be entertained;
 *utility and convenience take precedence, and every system must justify its existence by improving real outcomes.* 





  





 CynLr's ambition demands not only breakthrough algorithms and hardware, but also a
 *robust, adaptive, and human\-centric IT infrastructure* 
 that allows teams to operate with minimal friction and maximum focus. As CynLr scales across disciplines, tools, and geographies,
 *IT infrastructure becomes the information backbone of the organization.* 
 The goal of this role is not merely uptime or compliance, but to
 *augment human productivity* 
 , eliminate hidden delays and context\-switching costs, and ensure that technology remains an enabler rather than a constraint.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





***A. Operate***




  




* Run and maintain IT infrastructure supporting research, engineering, and operations at scale.
* Administer the Office 365 ecosystem (SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, identity and access).
* Operate and secure endpoint devices across Windows, Android, BYOD, and corporate assets.
* Manage network infrastructure including routers, switches, firewalls, Wi\-Fi, and VPNs.
* Perform hands\-on monitoring, troubleshooting, and incident resolution across hardware, OS, network, and applications.



  





***B. Build***




  




* Design and deploy Azure AD, Intune, and SharePoint policies for secure and organized access.
* Set up and maintain hardware infrastructure—laptops, workstations, servers, networking, and conferencing systems.
* Configure and support Windows Server, Linux, virtualization platforms (VMware / Hyper\-V).
* Establish remote workflows and inter\-office connectivity to enable distributed teams.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with hardware, software, and service vendors.



  





***C. Improve***



* Automate workflows and remediation using PowerShell scripting to reduce manual effort.
* Evaluate and select hardware and software based on supportability, ecosystem maturity, scalability, and lifecycle cost.
* Proactively monitor systems, analyse failures, and implement preventive and reliability improvements.
* Continuously refine IT processes and practices to remove friction and improve user productivity.



  





**Team Structure:** 



* The Operations team at CynLr functions as a
 *cross\-functional enablement layer* 
 that supports Engineering, Product, and Business teams in executing reliably and at scale. Within this structure, Technology and Systems responsibilities are owned as a core operational capability, ensuring that digital infrastructure, tools, and access evolve in step with how the organization works.
* Systems and IT operations are designed to be
 *deeply integrated into day\-to\-day execution* 
 , preserving context across teams and workflows. The function works closely with Engineering to support research and development needs, and with Operations and Finance to ensure reliability, security, and long\-term sustainability.



  





**What You’ll Need to Do This Well** 



* Strong understanding of computer hardware and workstations: CPU, memory, storage, BIOS/firmware and
 *how configuration choices impact developer productivity and system reliability.*
* Deep familiarity with
 *office productivity and collaboration systems,* 
 and the ability to
 *design workflows that reduce friction and context switching* 
 rather than add process overhead.
* Solid grounding in
 *networking fundamentals* 
 (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, firewalls) relevant to office, lab, and inter\-office environments.
* Clear understanding of
 *device configuration, identity management, and user access policies, balancing usability with security.*
* Working knowledge of
 *security principles, data protection, and basic database concepts,* 
 sufficient to design safe and scalable internal systems.



  





**Experience That Will Accelerate You** 



* Hands\-on experience with
 *DevOps or internal tooling infrastructure* 
 , especially in environments where tooling is still evolving.
* Experience setting up and maintaining databases or data services used internally by teams.
* Exposure to building IT systems in
 *fast\-moving, resource\-constrained environments where requirements change frequently.*
* *Experience supporting engineering\-heavy teams* 
 , including compute\-intensive workflows, development environments, and high\-performance workstations



  





**What will you do?** 



* You will design and operate the
 *digital infrastructure that enables CynLr’s teams to work without friction* 
 . Your role is to ensure that systems, tools, and access models support how people actually work across research, engineering, operations, and business functions.
* You will
 *translate organizational needs into reliable, secure, and intuitive IT systems, spanning devices, networks, collaboration tools, identity, and internal workflows* 
 . From onboarding a new team member to supporting compute\-heavy engineering setups, your work ensures that infrastructure never becomes the bottleneck to progress.
* You will proactively identify inefficiencies, hidden delays, and context\-switching costs in everyday workflows, and redesign systems to remove them so that teams can focus on solving hard problems, not fighting tools.



  





**How will you do it?** 



* The role demands a
 *systems\-first, entrepreneurial approach* 
 , suited to a deep\-tech environment where requirements evolve rapidly and standard enterprise playbooks often fall short.
* You will build strong context by working closely with teams, understanding how infrastructure decisions affect productivity, security, and reliability. You will question existing practices when they add friction, and design modular, scalable solutions that can adapt as CynLr grows.
* You will have the autonomy to rethink how systems are designed, deployed, and operated, with outcomes reviewed through the lens of
 *execution quality, reliability, usability, and long\-term sustainability.* 
 Success in this role comes from balancing hands\-on execution with thoughtful design solving today’s problems while building infrastructure that remains robust tomorrow.

* Hands\-on experience with networking devices such as Cisco switches/routers preferred
* Familiarity with firewall management and access control policies
* Certifications such as CompTIA A\+, Network\+, MCSA, or CCNA are preferred

title: Network Engineer
description:
This role has been designed as ‘Hybrid’ with an expectation that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge\-to\-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Aruba is an HPE Company, and a leading provider of next\-generation network access solutions for the mobile enterprise. Helping some of the largest companies in the world modernize their networks to meet the demands of a digital future, Aruba is redefining the “Intelligent Edge” – and creating new customer experiences across intelligent spaces and digital workspaces. Join us redefine what’s next for you.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
***Key Responsibilities***
* Designs, deploys, and supports enterprise HPE Aruba WLAN solutions, including HPE Access Points, Mobility Gateways, HPE Aruba Central, Clearpass, Airwave and related management and analytics platforms.
* Performs wireless troubleshooting, including RF analysis, client connectivity, roaming behavior, and performance optimization under guidance for complex scenarios.
* Assists with RF design activities, site surveys, and capacity planning to ensure optimal wireless coverage and performance.
* Collaborates with internal engineering, product, services, and support teams to resolve customer issues and improve solution quality.
* Reviews WLAN, Clearpass, Airwave configurations and deployments for alignment with HPE Support and Engineering standards and best practices.
* Participates in customer\-impacting incidents and escalations with support from senior engineers.
* Learns and applies emerging wireless technologies (Wi\-Fi 6/6E/7, security enhancements, and AI\-driven operations).
* Provides knowledge sharing and documentation to support team effectiveness.
* Supports customer engagements aligned to Americas business hours.
* Ready to work in Differential work schedule.


**What You Need To Bring**
***Education and Experience Required:***
* Education and Experience
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 \+ years of experience in enterprise networking and/or WLAN environments.
* 
* Knowledge and Skills
* Working knowledge of HPE Aruba WLAN technologies, including HPE Aruba APs, controllers/gateways, and Aruba Central.
* Understanding of IEEE 802\.11 fundamentals, RF concepts, and wireless security principles (WPA2/WPA3, 802\.1X).
* Exposure to wireless troubleshooting tools, packet captures, and spectrum analysis.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to follow structured troubleshooting approaches.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly in written and verbal form.
* Willingness and ability to learn new technologies in a fast\-paced networking environment.
* Ability to work effectively within a global organization, aligned to Americas time\-zone operations.
* 
* Professional Certifications (Preferred)
* HPE Aruba Certifications (ACMA/ACMP/ACA/ACP/ACNSA/ACNSP or equivalent)
* Entry\-level or associate wireless certifications such as CWNA or equivalent.


**Additional Skills**
 Cloud Architectures, Cross Domain Knowledge, Design Thinking, Development Fundamentals, DevOps, Distributed Computing, Microservices Fluency, Full Stack Development, Security\-First Mindset, User Experience (UX)
   

  

**What We Can Offer You**
**Health \& Wellbeing**
 We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.
   

  

**Personal \& Professional Development**
 We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.
   

  

**Unconditional Inclusion**
 We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

title: Project Manager - EPMO
description:

 We are committed to creating a flexible work environment for our people by supporting them to balance their work commitments and personal needs, both now and into the future.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**

 As a growing business we’re looking for likeminded people to join us \- we hope that’s you.

* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including IT, Technology and Innovation, Quality and Compliance, Finance, Clinical Operations and Senior Management to negotiate resource commitments and ensure on\-time delivery of projects.

title: Technical Program Manager
description:
**Role Summary** 


 Earnifi is seeking a Technical Program Manager (TPM) to drive execution across multiple engineering and technical initiatives in a fast\-moving fintech environment. This role will partner closely with Engineering, Product, Data, Underwriting and integration partner teams to ensure projects are planned, coordinated, and delivered successfully.
 





 The TPM will help bring structure, visibility, and accountability to complex initiatives while maintaining the agility required in a growing startup. The ideal candidate is highly organized, technically curious, comfortable working through ambiguity, and capable of managing multiple concurrent projects without introducing unnecessary process or bureaucracy.
 





 This role is well\-suited for someone who enjoys solving problems, coordinating stakeholders, and helping teams execute effectively in an environment where priorities evolve and new challenges emerge regularly.
 



**Responsibilities** 
**Program \& Project Delivery** 
* Lead execution of multiple concurrent technical projects and initiatives from planning through delivery.
* Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, milestones, dependencies, and status reporting.
* Coordinate activities across internal and external partner teams
* Track deliverables, risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies across active projects.
* Facilitate project meetings, status reviews, and stakeholder communications.

**Cross\-Functional Coordination** 
* Serve as a central point of coordination across technical and business teams.
* Ensure alignment between project objectives, priorities, and delivery commitments.
* Coordinate activities involving external vendors, technology partners, and service providers as needed.
* Facilitate communication between technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Escalate issues and blockers appropriately to maintain project momentum.


**Process \& Operational Excellence** 
* Introduce lightweight processes and tools that improve visibility, accountability, and execution.
* Support planning activities, roadmap coordination, and delivery forecasting.
* Maintain project documentation, decision logs, and reporting artifacts.
* Help establish repeatable delivery practices appropriate for a scaling startup environment.
* Contribute to continuous improvement efforts across engineering and technical operations.


**Compliance \& Risk Management** 
* Coordinate technical initiatives involving security, compliance, audit, regulatory, or operational requirements.
* Ensure key stakeholders are engaged throughout project lifecycles.
* Track remediation efforts, control implementation activities, and compliance\-related deliverables.
* Support audit readiness and documentation efforts as required.


**Qualifications** 
**Required** 
* 3–6 years of experience in technical program management, project management, engineering operations, product operations, consulting, or related roles.
* Experience coordinating multiple concurrent projects involving cross\-functional teams.
* Strong organizational, planning, and stakeholder management skills.
* Familiarity with software development lifecycles and Agile delivery practices.
* Experience using project management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, Linear, Asana, or similar platforms.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced environment with evolving priorities.
* Demonstrated ability to create structure and drive execution in environments with limited formal processes.


**Preferred** 
* Experience in fintech, payments, banking, payroll, or other regulated industries.
* Experience coordinating initiatives involving security, compliance, audit, or regulatory requirements.
* Familiarity with software development, APIs, cloud platforms, data systems, or modern software architectures.
* Experience working with distributed or remote engineering teams.
* Technical background in engineering, computer science, information systems, or a related discipline.


**Success Metrics** 
* Successful delivery of technical projects and initiatives.
* Improved visibility into project status, risks, dependencies, and commitments.
* Reduction in project delays caused by coordination or dependency issues.
* Increased predictability of delivery timelines and outcomes.
* Effective coordination across technical and business stakeholders.
* Positive stakeholder feedback from Engineering, Product, Compliance, and Operations teams.


**What Success Looks Like** 
* Creates enough structure to improve execution without slowing teams down.
* Keeps multiple projects moving forward simultaneously in a dynamic environment.
* Identifies risks, dependencies, and blockers early and drives resolution.
* Adapts quickly to changing priorities while maintaining focus on key deliverables.
* Enables teams to execute more effectively through coordination, communication, and accountability.
* Helps Earnifi scale its operational maturity while maintaining startup speed and flexibility.

o *Ask about the guests stay and feedbacks*

o *Print the bill and explain it to the guest*

o *Takepayment*

**About Us:**

Itvedant was started with the aim of bridging the gap between education and skills needed for the job with an intense passion for teaching. We are looking for dynamic and passionate people from the software industry to be a part of our family who can lead the team of students towards a bright future.


**JOB INTRODUCTION:**


A Career Guide supports individuals in making informed career choices by offering personalized advice on career paths, skill development, and job market trends. They assess clients' strengths and interests to recommend suitable career options and educational programs. Career Guides work with students, graduates, and professionals seeking career growth or change. Strong counseling and communication skills are key to helping clients achieve their career goals.Responsible for end to end student admission cycle.


**ROLES \& RESPONSIBILITIES:**  

* Evaluates student recruitment techniques by determining the effectiveness of each recruitment technique.
  
* Welcomes prospective students by processing paperwork; interviewing applicants; conducting follow\-up activities such as emails and phone\-calling campaigns.
  
* Handling of student enquiries effectively.
  
* Explaining the candidate about the available IT courses and its payment plans and resolving their doubts and queries accordingly.
  
* Following up with the candidate for joining the course/ programme and for the payment.
  
* Making follow up calls for due payments from the candidates.
  
* Timely updation and scheduling of upcoming batches to all the concerned team members, trainers and students.
  
* Achieving targets set by the Branch Manager.
  
* Maintain a MIS of the students who have taken admissions or have done enquiries
  
* Develops a healthy alumni network and arranges for student interactive sessions.
  
* Maintains recruiting operations by following policies and procedures; reporting needed changes.
  
* Enhances admissions department and institute reputation by accepting ownership for accomplishing new and different requests for admissions.
  
* Any other work allotted by the management.
  

**JOB QUALIFICATION \& SKILL SETS:**  

* A bachelor’s degree in psychology, counseling, human resources, education, or a related field. A master’s degree or certifications in career counseling is a plus.
  
* Experience in career counseling, coaching, HR, or a related field is often preferred.
  
* Certifications in career guidance or coaching (e.g., Certified Career Counselor) can be beneficial.
  
* Excellent verbal and written communication to provide clear guidance and support.
  
* Ability to present services effectively, address client concerns, and encourage commitment to career guidance programs.
  

**Perks \& Benefits :**  

* Attractive Incentive
  
* 12 Holidays and 21 leaves for the year
  
* Monthly, Quarterly \& Yearly Recognition
  
* Medical Insurance along with the family covered
  
* OPD facility along with the family covered
  
* Chance to win Indian \& International trips
  
* Career Growth Enhancement
  
* Continuous training \& development

description:
**Job Title: Senior Specialist \[CL 8] – Event Management**  

**Location:** Delhi/ NCR  

**Job Type:** Full\-Time, In Office on all days

**Department:** Accenture Workplace Services

**Reports to:** Workplace Event Management Manager \[CL 7]

 **Position Overview**:


The Event Planning \& Management, Senior Specialist is responsible for leading the strategy, planning, and execution of internal and client\-facing events that enhance workplace experience, strengthen brand presence, and support business objectives across our IT Services organization.


Operating within the Workplace \& Facilities function, this role ensures seamless delivery of events across corporate offices, innovation hubs, and hybrid environments. The Senior Specialist will drive operational excellence, governance, vendor partnerships, and continuous improvement across all event programs while aligning with corporate standards, compliance requirements, and cost optimization goals.


This role requires a strategic thinker with strong operational execution capabilities, cross\-functional leadership skills, and experience managing events within a corporate or technology\-driven environment.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Strategic Leadership:**

* Develop and execute a comprehensive workplace events strategy aligned with corporate, HR, and business unit objectives.
* Establish scalable event frameworks and standards across regional offices and global locations.
* Define KPIs to measure event effectiveness, employee engagement impact, ROI, and cost efficiency.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives to enhance event quality, sustainability, and innovation.
* Serve as the subject matter expert (SME) for workplace and corporate events within the organization.
* Identify emerging trends in corporate, hybrid, and technology\-enabled events.

**Event Management:**

* Lead end\-to\-end execution of internal and external events, including town halls, leadership summits, client engagements, workplace activations, and cultural initiatives.
* Oversee logistics including venue coordination, A/V, IT infrastructure setup, security, catering, branding, and facilities readiness.
* Manage onsite event operations and troubleshoot real\-time issues.
* Ensure compliance with health \& safety, security, and IT standards.
* Develop event timelines, run\-of\-show documentation, and contingency plans.
* Support hybrid and virtual event integration in collaboration with IT teams.

**Event Planning \& Optimization:**

* Standardize event intake, planning workflows, and resource allocation processes.
* Develop event playbooks, templates, and SOPs for consistency and scalability.
* Implement technology tools for event registration, tracking, and analytics.
* Optimize space utilization within corporate offices for events.
* Drive cost optimization initiatives through forecasting, budgeting, and vendor consolidation.
* Conduct post\-event analysis and apply lessons learned to future planning.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration:**

* Partner with HR, Marketing, Communications, IT, Security, and Business Leaders to align event objectives.
* Support executive leadership events with high\-touch coordination and confidentiality.
* Collaborate with Real Estate and Facilities teams to ensure venue readiness and compliance.
* Work closely with IT teams to support technical infrastructure needs (A/V, connectivity, digital signage).
* Align with Corporate Communications for branding and messaging consistency.
* Coordinate with Finance for budgeting, procurement, and expense management.

**Governance \& Reporting:**

* Establish governance frameworks for event approvals, budget controls, and compliance.
* Track and report on event performance metrics, cost savings, and operational KPIs.
* Ensure adherence to corporate procurement policies and risk management protocols.
* Maintain documentation and audit\-ready records for contracts, insurance, and compliance.
* Develop executive\-level dashboards and reporting summaries.
* Monitor sustainability and ESG considerations in event execution.

**Vendor and Asset Management:**

* Manage relationships with event vendors, venues, caterers, A/V providers, and logistics partners.
* Negotiate contracts and service\-level agreements (SLAs).
* Develop preferred vendor programs to improve service consistency and cost efficiency.
* Track and manage event\-related assets (furniture, technology, branding materials, digital equipment).
* Conduct vendor performance reviews and maintain scorecards.
* Oversee inventory management of event supplies and materials across locations.

 **Preferred Skills \& Certifications:**

* Certification such as CMP (Certified Meeting Professional) or CFM (Certified Facility Manager).
* Experience in global event coordination across multiple regions.
* Familiarity with ESG and sustainable event planning principles.
* Experience working in an IT Services or technology consulting organization.
* Knowledge of procurement and contract management systems.
* Experience supporting executive\-level events.

**Core Competencies**

* Strategic Thinking
* Operational Excellence
* Stakeholder Management
* Executive Presence
* Financial Acumen
* Risk Management
* Vendor Negotiation
* Project Management
* Communication \& Influence
* Problem Solving \& Agility
* Data\-Driven Decision Making
* Customer/Employee Experience Focus

  

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Event Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, Facilities Management, or related field.
* 12\-16\+ years of experience in corporate event planning within a technology or professional services environment.
* Experience supporting workplace, facilities, or corporate services functions.
* Strong budget management and vendor negotiation experience.
* Experience managing hybrid and virtual event environments.
* Knowledge of workplace operations and corporate real estate environments.
* Proficiency with event management software and Microsoft Office/Google Workspace.

title: Banking - Business Manager - Vice President
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of more than 230,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


**Vice President – BEU Team Lead**


**Location:** Mumbai, India \| **Level:** Vice President \| **Type:** Full\-Time \| **Team:** Business Expense Unit (BEU)


**About the Role**


We're seeking a Vice President to join our Business Expense Unit team. Leads global business T\&E operations for banking professionals, ensuring policy compliance, cost optimization, and process efficiency. Develops and implements strategic expense management frameworks, drives cost\-reduction initiatives, and strengthens internal audit controls. Leverages data analytics and ServiceNow reporting to monitor performance, identify trends, and support informed budget planning and decision\-making.


**What You'll Do**


**Team Leadership**

* Lead and inspire a team, fostering a culture of excellence and accountability
* Define team goals, KPIs, and performance objectives aligned with business priorities
* Conduct regular performance reviews and support career development of team members
* Manage resource planning, workload distribution, and team capacity
* Champion diversity and inclusion initiatives within the team
* Provide guidance and support to local team members; handle senior\-level escalations

**Stakeholder \& Banker Relationship Management**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for senior Bankers, Sponsors, and Business Execution Leads (BELs)
* Lead performance reviews with preferred partners and contribute to global strategic initiatives
* Manage vendor partnerships and senior\-level business relationships
* Collaborate across Finance, Compliance, Procurement, and HR

**Strategic Leadership \& Governance**


* Provide strategic and visionary leadership for the T\&E program
* Champion value creation, operational efficiency, governance, and control
* Oversee performance analytics; ensure KPIs and SLAs are consistently met
* Deliver actionable insights and management reporting to optimize travel spend
* Lead process improvement and change management initiatives

**Expense Report Management:**


* Oversee the timely and compliant preparation and review of banker expense reports, ensuring strict adherence to Operating Expense Governance Policy (OEGP).
* Develop and implement robust controls to identify and flag non\-reimbursable expenses and policy violations.
* Effectively manage escalations, disputes, and exceptions to ensure efficient reimbursement processes and mitigate financial risk.

**Expense Pre\-Check \& Quality Assurance:**


* Lead and optimize the pre\-check process for all submitted expense reports, establishing it as a critical quality control layer.
* Drive continuous improvement in first\-time\-right submission rates through targeted training programs for EAs and BELs on OEGP policy and Concur submission best practices.
* Monitor and analyse pre\-check metrics to identify trends and implement corrective actions.

**Corporate Card Program Oversight:**


* Direct the end\-to\-end corporate card reconciliation process, including the generation of comprehensive spend summaries and analysis.
* Implement strategies to assist bankers in achieving timely card settlement, thereby reducing delinquency rates.
* Establish rigorous monitoring mechanisms for card usage, promptly identifying and addressing anomalous transactions, and fostering strong relationships with banking partners.

**Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P) Operations (EMEA):**


* Manage and optimize the Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P) cycle, overseeing both PO and non\-PO invoice processing specifically within the EMEA region.
* Serve as the primary Business Area Owner (BAO) for new vendor onboarding initiatives, ensuring compliance and efficiency.
* Establish proactive measures for timely invoice settlement, including the diligent management of aging reports and strategic escalation of overdue items.

**What You'll Bring**


**Required:**


* 10\+ years of experience in travel program management or expense management, with proven leadership in corporate travel roles
* Demonstrated success in leading teams, driving change, and championing diversity and inclusion
* Expertise in managing senior\-level business relationships and complex vendor partnerships
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills
* Proficiency in Microsoft applications, SAP Concur, and leading travel management systems
* Strong analytical, organizational, and leadership capabilities
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple projects, and collaborate across time zones
* In\-depth knowledge of travel technology, policy development, and emerging industry trends
* Innovative and strategic thinker with a passion for continuous improvement

title: Hiring Manager
description:
A **hiring manager** is the department leader or supervisor who requests a new position, owns the talent pipeline for their specific team, and **holds the final authority to make the hiring decision**. Unlike full\-time HR professionals or internal recruiters who source candidates and manage corporate compliance, a hiring manager focuses on finding the right technical capability and cultural alignment to drive team productivity. \[1, 2, 3, 4, 5]The end\-to\-end roles and responsibilities of a hiring manager span five distinct phases of the talent acquisition lifecycle: \[1, 2]1\. Preparation and Role Definition

* **Identify Staffing Needs**: Assess current workloads to determine if a replacement or a brand\-new role is necessary to scale operations. \[1, 2]
* **Secure Requisition Approval**: Build the business case and negotiate salary budgets with senior executives or finance teams to get formal approval for the hire. \[1, 2]
* **Draft Job Descriptions**: Define required technical skills, daily responsibilities, mandatory qualifications, and key performance indicators (KPIs) in collaboration with HR. \[1, 2, 3]

2\. Recruitment Strategy and Sourcing

* **Align with the Recruiting Team**: Partner with internal recruiters to outline candidate profiles, establish realistic hiring timelines, and set up evaluation SLAs. \[1, 2]
* **Leverage Internal Networks**: Market the open position internally and proactively source talent via employee referral programs or professional industry networks. \[1, 2]
* **Refine Screening Filters**: Assist the talent acquisition team in optimizing applicant tracking system (ATS) filters and reviewing initial shortlists for highly specialized fields. \[1]

Pay: ₹180,000\.00 \- ₹200,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**Job Description: HR Manager** 




  





**Location:** 
 Dadar, Mumbai, India
 



**Department:** 
 HR
 



**Reports To:** 
 Management
 



  





**About Rynox** 




 Rynox is a fast\-growing retail brand with an ambitious expansion roadmap. We are building out our HR function from the ground up and we need someone who can own it.
 



  





 This is not a coordinator role. You will be the HR function. You will work directly with the Founder, lead a small team, and be responsible for everything from getting the right people in the door to making sure they are paid correctly, treated well, and set up to do their best work.
 



  





 If you want a role where you manage a process someone else designed, this is not it. If you want to build something and have the authority to do so, read on.
 



  





**WHAT WILL YOU OWN** 




**Recruitment:** 




 •   Partner with department heads to understand hiring needs and build pipelines that move fast
 



 •   Lead end\-to\-end recruitment across HQ and stores, from sourcing to offer closure
 



 •   Oversee and guide your executive on CV sourcing, candidate calling, and initial screening; you will review pipelines, coach on quality, and step in where needed
 



 •   Given the nature of retail, replacement hires must be closed within the notice period so that store operations are not impacted
 



 •   Negotiate offers, manage candidate experience, and ensure every new joiner has a strong first day
 



  





**HR Operations and Payroll:** 




 •   Run monthly payroll end\-to\-end, including inputs, processing, disbursement, and resolution of employee queries
 



 •   Manage all statutory compliance including PF and ESIC filings, on time, every time
 



 •   Own the employee lifecycle: onboarding, confirmations, transfers, exits, and Full and Final settlements
 



 •   Ensure all employee records, documentation, and compliance are always audit\-ready
 



  





**Employee Relations:** 




 •   Be the go\-to person for employees across HQ and all store locations for any HR\-related query or concern
 



 •   Handle salary and deduction queries with clarity and empathy
 



 •   Address grievances fairly and quickly; flag patterns to leadership with solutions
 



  





**Policy \& Process:** 




 •   Identify gaps in HR policy and build frameworks where none exist, covering leave, attendance, expenses, and more
 



 •   Get policies approved, communicate them clearly, and ensure they are followed
 



 •   Continuously improve processes to reduce manual effort and improve the employee experience
 



  





**Culture \& Engagement:** 




 •   Own the induction experience so every new joiner understands what Rynox stands for
 



 •   Create a culture of accountability and warmth, structured enough to scale and human enough to matter
 



 •   Drive small but meaningful engagement moments across the team
 



  





**Who We're Looking For:** 




 You have 3 to 6 years of HR experience, ideally in a retail or consumer brand. You have run payroll, handled compliance, hired at volume, and resolved the kind of messy people situations that do not come with a textbook answer.
 



  





 More importantly, you have the mindset of an owner. You do not wait to be told. You see what needs to be done and you do it. You are equally comfortable sitting with the Founder to discuss a policy and speaking with a store manager to sort out an issue on the ground.
 



  





**You should apply if you are:** 




 •   Execution\-first: you close things, you do not just initiate them
 



 •   Comfortable with ambiguity: processes here are being built, not inherited
 



 •   Empathetic with employees and firm on compliance
 



 •   A strong communicator in English and Hindi; Marathi is a plus
 



 •   Someone who treats HR as a business function, not an administrative one
 



  





**Why Rynox** 




 •   Direct access to the Founder; your decisions matter and you will see their impact immediately
 



 •   Real ownership of the HR function, not a cog in a large HR machine
 



 •   A brand that is growing and investing in its people infrastructure
 



 •   Collaborative, no\-politics environment where good work is recognised

* Understanding of the trade lifecycle for major financial asset classes across securities, exchange\-traded, and OTC derivatives

title: Granicus - Business Analyst ( 0-0 yrs )
description:
**Job Description**
 The Company
   

  

 Serving the People Who Serve the People
   

  

 Granicus is driven by the excitement of building, implementing, and maintaining technology that is transforming the Govtech industry by bringing governments and its constituents together. We are on a mission to support our customers with meeting the needs of their communities and implementing our technology in ways that are equitable and inclusive. Granicus has consistently appeared on the GovTech 100 list over the past 5 years and has been recognized as the best companies to work on BuiltIn.
   

  

 Over the last 25 years, we have served 5,500 federal, state, and local government agencies and more than 300 million citizen subscribers power an unmatched Subscriber Network that use our digital solutions to make the world a better place. With comprehensive cloud\-based solutions for communications, government website design, meeting and agenda management software, records management, and digital services, Granicus empowers stronger relationships between government and residents across the U.S., U.K., Australia, New Zealand, and Canada. By simplifying interactions with residents, while disseminating critical information, Granicus brings governments closer to the people they serve—driving meaningful change for communities around the globe.
   

  

 Want to know more? See more of what we do here .
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Business Systems Analyst I is a developing contributor who supports the implementation and enhancement of digital services for government clients. This role focuses on gathering and documenting business requirements, assisting with process analysis, and contributing to the delivery of solutions that meet defined client and project needs.
   

  

 The analyst collaborates with technical and non?technical stakeholders, applying strong communication and analytical skills to help translate business needs into system requirements. They work under guidance from senior analysts or project leaders, managing assigned tasks with increasing independence while building domain knowledge and technical understanding.
   

  

 The Business Systems Analyst I contributes to team success by supporting project documentation, participating in solution design discussions, and helping maintain project momentum. Success in this role requires a willingness to learn, attention to detail, adaptability, and a commitment to delivering high?quality work while developing professional and technical skills.
   

  

 What Your Impact Will Look Like
   

  

* Work with clients to gather system requirements and produce detailed requirements and functional specification documents to solve moderately complex problems within information systems.
* Analyze business and user needs, document requirements, and revise existing system logic difficulties as necessary.
* Validate, analysed and import initial and final data as approved by the customer.
* Work closely with the development team to ensure requirements are fully understood and provide assistance with overcoming obstacles faced during development.
* Conduct system testing at the development site and at the client site to validate requirements.
* Train end users and provide user support while ensuring the use of up\-to\-date user manuals during the operation phase or as requested by the supervisor.
* Consult with management to ensure agreement on system principles.
* Design, develop, and execute comprehensive test plans and test cases for user acceptance and ensure quality standards.
* Expand or modify systems to serve new purposes or improve current operations.
* Define the goals of the system and devise flow charts and diagrams describing the logical operational steps of programs.
* Serve as project leaders for particular systems projects.
* Document the experience in current projects to find new metrics, techniques, and strategies to improve targeting, measurements, and projects success in the future.
* Document reports design and specifications for custom reports development or modification.
* Provide support to the development team during development and testing.
* Contribute to project documentation by updating project binders and project sites as stated.
* Complete project tasks within establish deadlines and communicate delivery status to project team and management on a timely basis.
* Participation in the sales cycle will also be required. Consultants should be able to function equally as well independently or as part of a larger implementation team.
* Work with the product development team to identify potential product enhancements.
* Communicate with customers, competitors, suppliers, professional organizations, or others to stay abreast of industry or business trends.
* Communicate effectively with business representatives at all levels of the organization.
* Perform other tasks related to project or customer activities, as assigned by Supervisor.


 You Will Love This Job If You Have
   

  

* Excellent understanding or ERP fundamental software and tools.
* Knowledge of common best practice financial, accounting and business practices.
* Possess knowledge of governmental or local regulations that affect.
* Strong knowledge of systems’ implementation and testing methodology, best practices, and project phases.
* Ability to easily adapt to fast\-paced environment.
* Flexible during times of change, and deadline proximities.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills both in Spanish and English.
* Proficient using Microsoft Office tools (Word, Excel, Power Point, Project, and Access).
* Must be oriented to detail, teamwork and customer service.
* Strong organizational, communication, and presentation skills.
* High sense of professionalism.
* Strong analytical and problem solving skills.
* Ability to communicate and work fluently with business users, technical people and management across the organization.
* Excellent interpersonal skills.
* Proficient using Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, Power Point, and Outlook).
* Advance knowledge of Excel data management functionalities (e.g. macros, pivots), and financial reporting tools such as FRX and Management Reporter.
* Demonstrate an expert understanding of a variety of software modules including (but not limited to) General Ledger, Sales Order Processing and Accounts Receivables.
* Management, Purchasing and Payables Management, Human Resources, Payroll, Fixed.
* Assets and Bank Reconciliation. Knowledge of General Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP), Not\-for\-Profit and Governmental Accounting Standard Board (GASB) principles.
* Basic understanding of multi\-currency concepts.
* Basic knowledge of SQL, database and infrastructure concepts for ERP deployment.
* Understanding of Quality Assurance and Testing Principles
* This is a hybrid position, requiring a blend of remote and in\-office work. Additionally, the role includes on\-site visits to customers as needed, so candidates should be comfortable with traveling to all PR municipalities.


**About Us**
 Don’t have all the skills/experience mentioned above? At Granicus, we are trying to build diverse, inclusive teams. We do not have degree requirements for most of our roles. If you don’t meet every requirement above but are excited to learn more, we encourage you to apply. We might just be able to find another role that could be a perfect fit!
   

  

 Security And Privacy Requirements
   

  

* Responsible for Granicus information security by appropriately preserving the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability (CIA) of Granicus information assets in accordance with the company's information security program.
* Responsible for ensuring the data privacy of our employees and customers, their data, as well as taking all required privacy training in a timely manner, in accordance with company policies.


 The Team
   

  

* We are a remote\-first company with a globally distributed workforce across the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, India, Armenia, Australia, and New Zealand.


 The Culture
   

  

* At Granicus, we are building a transparent, inclusive, and safe space for everyone who wants to be a part of our journey.
* A few culture highlights include – Employee Resource Groups to encourage diverse voices
* Coffee with Mark sessions – Our employees get to interact with our CEO on very important and sometimes difficult issues ranging from mental health to work\-life balance and current affairs.
* Microsoft Teams communities focused on wellness, art, furbabies, family, parenting, and more.
* We bring in special guests from time to time to discuss issues that impact our employee population


 The Impact
   

  

* We are proud to serve dynamic organizations around the globe that use our digital solutions to make the world a better place — quite literally. We have so many powerful success stories that illustrate how our solutions are impacting the world. See more of our impact here .

title: AI Automation Engineer
description:
**About the Role \-**  

We’re a fast\-growing technology company building AI\-powered automations to run leaner and ship faster. We’re looking for sharp, self\-driven freshers and interns who genuinely enjoy building with AI — people who would rather create a workflow that handles a task 100 times than do it manually once. This is a pure automation and tooling role. You will work directly with the founder and teams to find repetitive processes and turn them into reliable, AI\-assisted pipelines. Your job is to build the automations — not to work in any specialist domain. You will start building and shipping real automation from week one.  

  

**What You’ll Do** • Build and maintain automation workflows using n8n, Make.com, or Zapier to connect internal systems (CRM, email, ticketing, reporting). • Use LLM APIs (Claude, OpenAI) and strong prompt engineering to automate report drafting, data extraction, summarization, and research workflows. • Build internal AI tools — RAG\-based knowledge assistants, document generators, and simple dashboards that teams actually use every day. • Identify manual, repetitive processes across the company and turn them into reliable automated pipelines. • Work with structured and unstructured data (PDFs, spreadsheets, logs) to clean, parse, and feed it into automated workflows. • Test, document, and iterate on everything you build so others can trust and reuse it.  

  

  

**Tools You’ll Work With** \-You’ll get hands\-on experience with a modern automation stack: • LLM APIs: OpenAI, Claude • Automation Platforms: n8n, Make.com, Zapier • Languages \& Frameworks: Python, LangChain, CrewAI • Data \& Integrations: REST APIs, Webhooks, Vector Databases • Tools: GitHub, Google Workspace, Notion What We’re Looking For • Genuine interest in AI and automation — you’ve already experimented with ChatGPT/Claude, n8n/Make/Zapier, or similar tools on your own. • Basic coding ability (Python preferred) — enough to write scripts, call APIs, and debug simple issues. • Logical, structured thinking — you can break a messy manual process into clear, automatable steps. • Strong ownership \& curiosity — you figure things out, ask good questions, and take initiative without waiting to be told what to do. • Good written English for documentation and prompt writing

description:
**Job Description: Security Analyst L1**   
**Location:** Delhi (Onsite) **Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Experience Level:** Entry Level / Fresher  
**Joining:** Immediate Joiners Only  
**Company Name:** Marven Data Systems Pvt Ltd

**Role Overview:**

We are seeking a sharp, articulate, and proactive **Security Analyst** to join our offensive security team in Delhi. In this role, you will be deployed onsite at client location.

As the on\-ground representative of our security team, you must combine technical curiosity in ethical hacking with **exceptional communication skills** to seamlessly collaborate with client IT teams and explain security findings clearly.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Assessment Execution:** Run scoped vulnerability assessments across client networks, web applications, and endpoints under the guidance of senior consultants.
* **Client Interface s Communication:** Act as the primary on\-site point of contact.
* Explain the deployment process, outline project prerequisites, and manage client expectations professionally.
* **Triage s Troubleshooting:** Identify and resolve technical roadblocks during the exercise while keeping the client transparently updated.
* **Reporting s Debriefing:** Assist in compiling clear, structured VAPT reports. Deliver basic verbal walkthroughs of identified vulnerabilities and proof\-of\-concepts to client technical teams.

**Qualifications \& Requirements:**

· **Communication Skills (Critical):**

* Flawless verbal and written English and Hindi communication skills.
* The ability to confidently explain technical risks to client IT managers without sounding confrontational.
* Strong technical writing skills for drafting vulnerability executive summaries.

**· Advantage having Technical Knowledge:**

* Solid understanding of the **OWASP Top 10** (for web apps) and infrastructure security concepts.
* Familiarity with common VAPT tools (Kali Linux, Metasploit, Nmap, Burp Suite, Nessus).
* Good understanding of networking protocols (TCP/IP, HTTP, SSH) and how to navigate Linux/Windows command lines.
* **Education:** B.E. / B.Tech / BCA / B.Sc in Cyber Security, Computer Science, IT, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred (Bonus) Qualifications**

* Practical experience from Bug Bounty programs, Hack The Box, or TryHackMe.
* Relevant certifications: Certified Ethical Hacker (**CEH**), CompTIA **PenTest\+**, or **eJPT**.
* Prior experience in public speaking, technical presentations, or client\-facing college leadership roles.

**Key Job Details \& Benefits**

* **Immediate Availability:** Candidates must be available to join within 0–7 days.
* **Onsite Presence:** 100% onsite role requiring daily travel to corporate client sites across Delhi NCR.

title: Sound Engineer
description:
**About Sukudo Studios**

**Sukudo Studios** is a **TPN\-certified dubbing and localization studio** built for the new economics of content. We deliver **end\-to\-end dubbing, voice\-over, subtitling, and audio post\-production** across **50\+ languages** for **short drama platforms, OTT originals, films, web series, and YouTube creators worldwide**.

Our entire production pipeline runs **in\-house**, allowing us to handle **high\-volume bulk projects with some of the fastest turnaround times in the industry**. With a network of **500\+ voice artists**, **25,000\+ projects delivered**, and **TPN content security certification**, Sukudo Studios is trusted by content producers globally to bring their stories to every audience, in every language.

**Job Overview**

Sukudo Studios is looking for a **Recording Engineer / Dubbing Engineer** to join our growing studio team. We are seeking someone who is **technically strong, detail\-oriented, and passionate about audio production**, with **0–4 years of experience** in recording, dubbing, voice\-over, or studio operations.

This role is ideal for candidates who have a solid understanding of **audio fundamentals, recording workflows, dubbing sessions, studio equipment, and artist coordination**. Freshers with strong practical training and a genuine interest in studio recording are also encouraged to apply.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Record and manage **dubbing, voice\-over, and voice recording sessions** with artists
* Set up and operate **microphones, preamps, headphones, audio interfaces, and studio recording equipment**
* Conduct **sound checks** and ensure recordings are clean, balanced, and free from noise or technical issues
* Guide, cue, and communicate effectively with **voice artists** during sessions
* Maintain proper **recording levels, gain staging, and overall session quality**
* Perform **basic editing tasks** such as:
* Breath removal
* Cleaning takes
* Comping
* Cutting and organizing recordings
* Organize **session files, folder structures, naming conventions, and backups** systematically
* Identify and troubleshoot recording issues such as **clipping, plosives, sibilance, distortion, and background noise**
* Ensure all **studio equipment is maintained and functioning properly**
* Coordinate with internal teams and support **mixing engineers / technical team members** as needed
* Work efficiently in a **high\-volume production environment** while maintaining quality standards and turnaround timelines

**Required Skills**

* Strong understanding of **audio engineering and recording fundamentals**
* Knowledge of:
* **Gain staging**
* **Microphone placement**
* **Signal flow**
* **Monitoring levels**
* **Room acoustics basics**
* Hands\-on experience with at least one **DAW** such as:
* **Pro Tools**
* **Logic Pro**
* **Cubase**
* **Ableton Live**
* or similar
* Understanding of **sample rate, bit depth, recording formats, and session setup**
* Basic to intermediate knowledge of:
* **EQ**
* **Compression**
* **Noise reduction / cleanup**
* Ability to identify and manage issues like:
* Clipping
* Plosives
* Sibilance
* Unwanted noise
* Distortion
* Comfortable handling **condenser microphones, preamps, headphones, and studio hardware**
* Good communication skills and confidence in working directly with **voice artists and studio teams**
* Strong attention to detail, organization, and ability to work under deadlines

**Eligibility / Qualifications**

* **0–4 years of experience** as a **Recording Engineer, Dubbing Engineer, Audio Engineer**, or in a similar studio role
* **Freshers with strong practical knowledge of recording and dubbing workflows may also apply**
* Diploma, degree, or certification in **Audio Engineering, Sound Technology, Music Production, or a related field** is preferred

**Who Should Apply**

This role is a good fit for someone who:

* Wants hands\-on experience in a **fast\-paced dubbing and localization studio**
* Has a strong interest in **voice recording, dubbing, and post\-production workflows**
* Can balance **technical precision** with **artist handling and studio coordination**
* Enjoys working on **high\-volume content projects** across multiple languages and formats

**Why Join Sukudo Studios**

* Work with a **TPN\-certified studio** trusted by global content producers
* Be part of a team handling **OTT, films, web series, short dramas, and creator content**
* Gain exposure to **large\-scale multilingual dubbing and localization workflows**
* Collaborate with a network of **500\+ voice artists**
* Learn and grow in a **high\-output, high\-learning studio environment**

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates can apply with their updated resume or mail us at: hr@sukudostudios.com

* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time

description:
**Job Description**
-------------------


Are you the person who is always planning the next trip, discovering new artists, tracking upcoming festivals and experiences, and convincing friends to join you on the adventure?


Do you dream of building a career at the intersection of travel, music, culture, community, and live experiences?


We’re looking for someone who is passionate about experiences and excited to help build unique journeys, community\-led experiences, festival trips, special projects, and new ideas from the ground up.


You’ll work across a diverse range of projects spanning travel, hospitality, music, festivals, community, culture, entertainment, and new experience\-led initiatives across the Zo ecosystem.


This is not a traditional desk job.


One week, you might be researching a destination, identifying an emerging festival, helping build an itinerary, brainstorming a new experience, or supporting a marketing campaign. The next week, you could be coordinating with partners, assisting with on\-ground execution, or helping bring an experience to life.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

### **Experience Development \& Research**

* Research destinations, festivals, events, communities, creators, and emerging trends.
